ingles: Professor Watson is a new hire at Minerva Bay College, teaching economics to the likes of Dylan and the main character. She's known to be mean and likes to tease her students, especially Dylan since he failed her class once before. Still, she has a passion for her subject and her well-endowed bosom.
espanol: Professor Watson ist neu am Minerva Bay College und unterrichtet Dylan und den Protagonisten in Wirtschaft. Sie ist bekannt dafür, gemein zu sein und ihre Schüler zu necken, vor allem Dylan, weil er schon mal in ihrem Kurs durchgefallen ist. Sie liebt ihr Fach und ihren üppigen Busen.

ingles: Professor Watson is the stereotype of a hot teacher, and she knows it. With her arrogance and self-confidence, she both seduces and intimidates her students, known to make inappropriate and embarrassing comments. Will the main character be able to resist the pressure she brings?
espanol: Professor Watson ist der Inbegriff einer heißen Lehrerin und sie weiß das auch. Mit ihrer Arroganz und ihrem Selbstbewusstsein verführt und schüchtert sie ihre Studenten ein, die dafür bekannt sind, unangemessene und peinliche Kommentare abzugeben. Wird der Protagonist dem Druck, den sie ausübt, standhalten können?
Jemand, bei dem man Dampf ablassen kann

ingles: Gabby is the newest lead at Angela and Devilla's bar. She's sweet, kind, and a great listener. She attends the same university as the main character and is terrified that her teachers and the faculty might learn about her side hustle.
espanol: Gabby ist der neuste Hingucker in Angelas und Devillas Bar. Sie ist süß, freundlich und eine gute Zuhörerin. Sie besucht dieselbe Universität wie der Protagonist und hat panische Angst, dass ihre Lehrer und die Fakultät von ihrem Nebenjob erfahren könnten.

ingles: Gabby's dream is to become a famous scientist, but she is willing to do whatever it takes to pay her bills and graduate college —that is, as long as she can be discreet about it and make sure it doesn't ruin her reputation.
espanol: Gabbys Traum ist es, eine bekannte Wissenschaftlerin zu werden, doch derzeit ist sie bereit, alles zu tun, um ihre Rechnungen zu bezahlen und ihr Studium abzuschließen zu können – solange sie dabei diskret vorgehen kann und ihren Ruf nicht ruiniert.

ingles: You scratch my back, and I'll scratch yours

Carolyne is a nurse who's been known to take jobs for Fred. She doesn't ask questions and doesn't want to answer any either. She's mysterious and keeps both her past and the circumstances she met Fred under a secret.
espanol: Carolyne ist eine Krankenschwester, die Aufträge für Fred annimmt. Sie stellt keine Fragen und will auch keine beantworten. Sie ist geheimnisvoll und hält sowohl ihre Vergangenheit als auch die Umstände, unter denen sie Fred kennenlernte, geheim.

ingles: Carolyne seems to be a trustworthy person, willing to help the main character with his daddy issues. She's charming and confident, seeming to honestly care about the main character's well-being.
espanol: Carolyne wirkt wie jemand, dem man vertrauen kann und dem Protagonisten bei seinen Problemen mit seinem Vater helfen will. Sie ist charmant und selbstbewusst und scheint sich wirklich um das Wohl des Hauptcharakters zu kümmern.

ingles: Mae is a regular customer of Susan's. She is a masseuse with a particular interest in the main character after he's tasked with delivering a package to her. Mae is soft-spoken and very eager to get her hands on whatever man comes her way.
espanol: Mae ist Stammkundin bei Susan. Sie ist Masseurin und interessiert sich besonders für den Protagonisten, nachdem er ihr ein Paket gebracht hat. Mae ist sanft und sehr daran interessiert, jeden Mann, der ihr über den Weg läuft, in ihre Hände zu bekommen.

ingles: Mae cares a lot about her looks, so she doesn't look her age even though she's in her forties. She seems to be an influential person in Minerva Bay, and although she's discreet, she seems to take a liking to the younger boys...
espanol: Mae legt viel Wert auf ihr Aussehen, weswegen sie nicht wie eine Frau in den Vierzigern aussieht. Sie scheint in Minerva Bay eine einflussreiche Person zu sein und obwohl sie zurückhaltend ist, scheint sie eine Vorliebe für jüngere Männer zu haben ...

ingles: If life gives you lemons... use them to shoot vodka!
espanol: Wenn dir das Leben Zitronen gibt ... mach Wodka daraus!

ingles: Dylan is the main character's best friend. He's carefree and always joking — with a flair for the dramatic. Although he talks normally around the main character, Dylan pretends to be Russian around the ladies.
espanol: Dylan ist der beste Kumpel des Protagonisten. Er ist total locker und macht immer Witze – mit einem Hang zum Dramatischen. Obwohl er mit dem Protagonisten ganz normal redet, tut Dylan vor den Mädchen so, als wäre er Russe.

ingles: Even though he's somehow managed to hide this big secret from others, Dylan is a great friend that the main character can count on for even the craziest of adventures. He would literally drive across the country to get a friend out of trouble.
espanol: Auch wenn er es irgendwie geschafft hat, dieses große Geheimnis vor anderen zu verbergen, ist Dylan ein toller Kumpel, auf den sich der Protagonist selbst bei den verrücktesten Abenteuern verlassen kann. Er würde buchstäblich quer durchs Land fahren, um einen Freund aus der Patsche zu helfen.

ingles: I'd do anything for my family
espanol: Ich würde alles für meine Familie tun.

ingles: The main character's mother is a loving person, but she can be rather overprotective and seems to know more than she lets on. She can be a bit overbearing, but it's always with the best of intentions.
espanol: Die Mutter der Hauptfigur ist eine liebevolle Person, kann aber ziemlich überfürsorglich sein und scheint mehr zu wissen, als sie zugibt. Sie kann ein bisschen herrisch sein, aber immer mit den besten Absichten.

ingles: Debra loves Fred unconditionally, leaving questions about how complicit she was in Fred's business. Perhaps she really was completely oblivious to everything that happened in the past.
espanol: Debra liebt Fred bedingungslos, was Fragen darüber aufwirft, wie sehr sie in Freds Geschäfte verwickelt war. Vielleicht hat sie wirklich nichts von dem mitbekommen, was in der Vergangenheit passiert ist.

ingles: I have to prove my innocence
espanol: Ich muss beweisen, dass ich unschuldig bin.

ingles: Fred is the main character's father. He's been missing for fifteen years after a bad deal went south, leading to his being arrested. He wants to be reunited with his family more than anything else and is willing to do whatever it takes to do so.
espanol: Fred ist der Vater des Protagonisten. Er ist seit fünfzehn Jahren verschwunden, nachdem ein mieser Deal schiefgelaufen ist und er verhaftet wurde. Er will unbedingt wieder mit seiner Familie zusammen sein und ist bereit, alles dafür zu tun.

ingles: On top of that, Fred seeks revenge against the person he believes to be truly responsible for his fate and will do everything to ensure that the truth about his past is revealed and that the guilty parties are punished.
espanol: Außerdem will Fred Rache an der Person nehmen, von der er denkt, dass sie für sein Schicksal verantwortlich ist, und wird alles dafür tun, die Wahrheit über seine Vergangenheit ans Licht zu bringen und die Schuldigen zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen.

ingles: Sam is Lily's husband and the co-owner of a large investment firm. He's possessive and gets angry easily. When he's at his best though, he is an extremely charming man. He did a lot of business with Fred in the past and is one of the prime suspects behind his disappearance.
espanol: Sam ist Lilys Mann und Teilhaber einer großen Investmentfirma. Er ist ziemlich eifersüchtig und wird schnell sauer. Wenn er aber gut drauf ist, ist er ein super charmanter Typ. Er hat früher viel mit Fred gemacht und ist einer der Hauptverdächtigen in seinem Verschwinden.

ingles: After all his investigating, the main character is convinced that Sam is the real villain behind his father's disappearance. But will the main character be able to prove his suspicions?
espanol: Nach all seinen Nachforschungen ist der Protagonist davon überzeugt, dass Sam der wahre Bösewicht hinter dem Verschwinden seines Vaters ist. Aber wird er seine Vermutungen beweisen können?

ingles: Charlie was Susan's husband and a partner of both Fred and Sam. He always stood for what was right in the business, so when things took a turn for the worse, he was quick to turn on his partners. This, in turn, made Fred and Sam resent him.
espanol: Charlie war Susans Ehemann und Partner von Fred und Sam. Er stand stets für das Richtige im Geschäft ein und wandte sich deswegen schnell gegen seine Partner, als die Dinge sich zum Schlechteren wendeten. Das wiederum brachte ihm den Groll von Fred und Sam ein.

ingles: Charlie passed away in a traffic accident a few years ago.
espanol: Charlie ist vor ein paar Jahren bei einem Verkehrsunfall ums Leben gekommen.

ingles: Life is a mole on a chick's ass... You just got to have fun with it!
espanol: Das Leben ist wie ein Muttermal auf dem Arsch eines Mädchens ... Man muss einfach Spaß damit haben!

ingles: Bruce is a senior at Minerva Bay College and the head of the Sigma-Pi-Nu fraternity. Along with his girlfriend Heather, he organizes parties and other events to welcome the freshmen to campus, enjoying when he can cause mayhem and mischief at the university. The more epic, the better!
espanol: Bruce studiert im letzten Jahr am Minerva Bay College und ist der Vorsitzende der Studentenverbindung Sigma-Pi-Nu. Zusammen mit seiner Freundin Heather organisiert er Partys und andere Veranstaltungen, um die Erstsemester auf dem Campus willkommen zu heißen. Er genießt es, an der Uni für Chaos und Unfug zu sorgen. Je spektakulärer, desto besser!

ingles: Well... let's see what you're capable of.
espanol: Also ... Mal sehen, was du drauf hast.

ingles: Heather is a senior at Minerva Bay College, and she doesn't seem to like the main character very much. She's Bruce's girlfriend, and she enjoys picking on the freshmen during fraternity events. The main character wants to do everything he can to convince her that he is, in fact, a nice guy who deserves her respect. But will he succeed?
espanol: Heather studiert im letzten Jahr am Minerva Bay College und scheint den Protagonisten nicht besonders zu mögen. Sie ist Bruces Freundin und ärgert sich gerne über die Erstsemester bei den Veranstaltungen der Studentenverbindung. Der Protagonist will alles tun, um sie davon zu überzeugen, dass er ein netter Kerl ist, der ihren Respekt verdient. Aber wird er Erfolg haben?
Das lass ich mir nicht gefallen!

ingles: Donna is the vice dean at Minerva Bay College and is currently extremely unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. With her aggressive and uncompromising stance, she vows to combat lewd behavior from her students, known to fight fiercely for morals and righteous behavior.
espanol: Donna ist die Vizedekanin am Minerva Bay College und echt unzufrieden mit der Richtung, die die Uni gerade einschlägt. Mit ihrer aggressiven und kompromisslosen Art will sie gegen das unanständige Verhalten ihrer Studenten vorgehen und ist bekannt dafür, dass sie sich stark für Moral und korrektes Verhalten einsetzt.

ingles: When Donna discovers that some university students work and live at a local bar that is home to a number of unbecoming activities, she begins a campaign against the owners.
espanol: Als Donna herausfindet, dass ein paar Studenten in einer Bar arbeiten und leben, wo es ziemlich wild zugeht, startet sie eine Aktion gegen die Besitzer.

ingles: Maybe we can solve this with a simple conversation
espanol: Vielleicht können wir das mit einem einfachen Gespräch klären.

ingles: Jack is the dean of the university, but his position seems to be under threat from Donna, unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. Jack doesn't seem to be making any effort to maintain morality and righteous behavior within the university. In fact, he might even be taking a few liberties with his power. However, this has left some members of the board less than pleased. Could his position be under threat?
espanol: Jack ist der Dekan der Uni, aber Donna, die mit der Richtung, in die sich die Uni entwickelt, nicht zufrieden ist, scheint ihm seinen Job streitig zu machen. Jack scheint sich nicht wirklich darum zu kümmern, dass an der Uni alles mit rechten Dingen läuft. Er scheint sogar seine Macht ein bisschen zu missbrauchen. Das gefällt einigen Mitgliedern des Verwaltungsrats gar nicht. Könnte sein Job in Gefahr sein?

ingles: This isn't in the rules... but I'll see what I can do.
espanol: Das steht zwar nicht in den Regeln, aber ich werde mal schauen, was ich machen kann.

ingles: Janine works at Minerva Bay College as a secretary. She has a soft spot for Dylan but is otherwise a very conservative person who values 'decency' above all else.
espanol: Janine ist Sekretärin am Minerva Bay College. Sie hat ein Faible für Dylan, ist aber ansonsten ziemlich konservativ und legt großen Wert auf Anstand.

ingles: What luck! It must be because the planets are aligned!
espanol: Was für ein Glück! Das muss daran liegen, dass die Planeten günstig stehen!

ingles: Jessa is athletic, full of attitude, and has a biting sense of humor. She's a freshman at Minerva Bay College is looking for alternative ways to earn more money to support herself.
espanol: Jessa ist sportlich, hat eine starke Persönlichkeit und einen bissigen Humor. Sie studiert im ersten Jahr am Minerva Bay College und sucht nach alternativen Möglichkeiten, mehr Geld für ihren Lebensunterhalt zu verdienen.

ingles: Jessa heard there was a local bar recruiting girls to work there and saw it as a good opportunity to get some extra income. She sees the looks men are always giving her, and she doesn't mind using that to her advantage.
espanol: Jessa hat gehört, dass eine Bar in der Nähe Mädels sucht, und denkt, das wäre 'ne gute Chance, um etwas dazu zu verdienen. Sie weiß, dass die Männer sie oft anschauen, und hat kein Problem damit, das zu ihrem Vorteil zu nutzen.

ingles: This is awkward... but maybe we can work with it.
espanol: Das ist peinlich ... aber vielleicht können wir damit arbeiten.

ingles: Chery is a shy girl who devotes herself to her studies. Being so intelligent and in her own head all the time, she has a bit of difficulty with social situations... That is, until she received a mysterious proposal about a local bar recruiting girls to work there.
espanol: Chery ist ein schüchternes Mädchen, das sich voll und ganz ihrem Studium widmet. Da sie so intelligent und ständig mit sich selbst beschäftigt ist, hat sie im Umgang mit anderen etwas Schwierigkeiten ... Doch dann wird ihr gesagt, dass eine Bar in der Nähe Mädchen sucht, die dort arbeiten wollen.

ingles: Although Chery was initially uncomfortable with the idea, she eventually reconsidered and accepted the invitation to join Hell Angels. After all, she really needed the extra money...
espanol: Obwohl Chery die Idee zunächst nicht mochte, überlegte sie es sich schließlich anders und nahm die Einladung an, den Hell Angels beizutreten. Schließlich brauchte sie das zusätzliche Geld wirklich …

ingles: Oh, I remember you... You're the guy who never showed up!
espanol: Oh, ich erinnere mich an dich ... Du bist der Typ, der nie aufgetaucht ist!

ingles: Madison is Chloe's friend, another member of the book club. the main character doesn't know much about her, but she definitely caught his eye... A fact that she didn't seem to object to.
espanol: Madison ist Chloes Freundin und auch im Buchclub. Der Protagonist weiß nicht viel über sie, aber sie ist ihm auf jeden Fall aufgefallen ... und das fand sie anscheinend auch ganz gut.

ingles: Soft spoken and a good listener
Maybe we can help each other out.
espanol: Vielleicht können wir uns gegenseitig helfen.

ingles: Laura is the police officer who approaches the main character after she opens up an old case linked to the events surrounding Fred and his disappearance. She became a police officer after seeing her father being wronged and forced to pay for a crime he didn't commit.
espanol: Laura ist die Polizistin, die sich dem Protagonisten nähert, nachdem sie einen alten Fall im Zusammenhang mit den Ereignissen rund um Fred und sein Verschwinden wieder aufgerollt hat. Sie wurde Polizistin, nachdem sie miterlebt hatte, wie ihrem Vater Unrecht widerfuhr und er für ein Verbrechen büßen musste, das er nicht begangen hatte.

ingles: Since then, Laura has decided to help people who find themselves in similar situations to hers to prevent others from being wrongfully convicted. She seems quite helpful and persuasive, two qualities that could help her become a strong ally in the main character's search for the truth.
espanol: Seitdem hat Laura beschlossen, Menschen in ähnlichen Situationen zu helfen, um zu verhindern, dass andere zu Unrecht verurteilt werden. Sie wirkt hilfsbereit und überzeugend – zwei Eigenschaften, die bei der Suche des Protagonisten nach der Wahrheit helfen könnten.

ingles: Tyler is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. He and Claire are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, he shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether he's friend or foe there.
espanol: Tyler ist ein Neuling am Minerva Bay College und geht auch in Alyssas Tanzschule. Er und Claire sind schon seit der Kindheit befreundet und immer zusammen unterwegs. Bei dem Wettkampf der Studentenverbindungen taucht er unter den Teilnehmern auf, aber es bleibt abzuwarten, ob er dort Freund oder Feind ist.

ingles: Claire is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. She and Tyler are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, she shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether she's friend or foe to the girls there.
espanol: Claire ist ein Neuling am Minerva Bay College und geht auch in Alyssas Tanzschule. Sie und Tyler sind schon seit der Kindheit befreundet und immer zusammen unterwegs. Bei dem Wettkampf der Studentenverbindungen taucht sie unter den Teilnehmern auf, aber es bleibt abzuwarten, ob sie dort Freund oder Feind ist.
Lasst uns auf die Plakate kritzeln!

ingles: Greg is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competitions. He is tall, strong, and bald. Though that certainly gives him a menacing appearance, the reality is far from it. On the contrary, he's goofy, simple-minded, and borderline cute at times. He dresses like a metalhead and likes to draw. You can see the soul of an artist lurking within.
espanol: Greg ist ein Erstsemester am Minerva Bay College und nimmt an den Wettbewerben der Studentenverbindung teil. Er ist groß, stark und glatzköpfig. Das verleiht ihm zwar ein bedrohliches Aussehen, doch in Wirklichkeit ist er dsa Gegenteil davon: albern, einfältig und manchmal fast schon niedlich. Er kleidet sich wie ein Metalhead und zeichnet gerne. Man sieht ihm die Seele eines Künstlers an.

ingles: May the force be with me
espanol: Möge die Macht mit mir sein

ingles: Ned is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and although he doesn't seem very threatening, he can be a handful. He's also a huge Science Fiction fan and sometimes dresses up as a Jedi...
espanol: Ned ist ein Erstsemester am Minerva Bay College und nimmt am Verbindungswettbewerb teil. Er ist im Team, das gegen den Protagonisten antritt, und obwohl er nicht sehr bedrohlich wirkt, kann er ganz schön anstrengend sein. Er ist außerdem ein großer Science-Fiction-Fan und verkleidet sich manchmal als Jedi …

ingles: You'll never gonna beat me, Sigma Boy!
espanol: Du wirst mich nie schlagen, Sigmabursche!

ingles: Josh is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and every hint leads the main character to believe he'll be trouble. In addition to being a strong competitor, he's singled out the main character as his main rival and wants to make that crystal clear.
espanol: Josh ist ein Erstsemester am Minerva Bay College und nimmt am Verbindungswettbewerb teil. Er ist im Team, das gegen den Protagonisten antritt, und alles deutet darauf hin, dass er ihm Ärger machen wird. Er ist nicht nur ein starker Konkurrent, sondern hat den Protagonisten auch als seinen größten Rivalen ausgemacht und möchte das auch klarstellen.

ingles: Kaylee is Josh's partner during the sorority competitions. We don't know much about her, but she's definitely a freshman at Minerva Bay College... or she wouldn't be competing.
espanol: Kaylee ist Joshs Partnerin bei den Wettkämpfen der Studentinnenverbindung. Wir wissen nicht viel über sie, aber sie ist definitiv im ersten Jahr am Minerva Bay College ... sonst würde sie ja nicht mitmachen.

ingles: He's the bouncer at Hell Angels, a local bar. We don't know much about him... After all, he's not much of a talker.
espanol: Er ist der Türsteher im Hell Angels, einer Bar hier in der Gegend. Wir wissen nicht viel über ihn ... Er ist schließlich kein großer Redner.

ingles: With thanks, a gift for you
espanol: Mit Dankeschön ein Geschenk für dich

ingles: As a thank you to everyone who continues to believe in our project and chose to support the game by purchasing the Supporter Pack, we've prepared a special gift: an exclusive 3D-printable file for a figurine of Julia.
espanol: Als Dankeschön an alle, die an unser Projekt glauben und das Spiel mit dem Supporter-Pack unterstützen, haben wir ein besonderes Geschenk für euch: eine exklusive 3D-druckbare Datei für eine Statue von Julia.

ingles: This gift is more than just a digital item — it's a symbol of appreciation for those who helped make the game possible. We designed this statue for the fans who truly care about the world we're building and want to bring a piece of it into their own homes.
espanol: Dieses Geschenk ist mehr als nur ein digitaler Gegenstand – es ist ein Zeichen der Wertschätzung für alle, die dazu beigetragen haben, das Spiel möglich zu machen. Wir haben diese Statue für Fans entworfen, denen die Welt, die wir erschaffen, wirklich am Herzen liegt und die ein Stück davon in ihr Zuhause holen möchten.

ingles: We know that supporting a game is an act of trust and passion, and this small tribute is our way of giving something meaningful back — something personal, unique, and made to be proudly displayed.
espanol: Wir wissen, dass die Unterstützung eines Spiels ein Zeichen von Vertrauen und Leidenschaft ist, und mit dieser kleinen Aufmerksamkeit möchten wir euch etwas Sinnvolles zurückgeben – etwas Persönliches, Einzigartiges und etwas, das man mit Stolz präsentieren kann.

ingles: To download the statue file, log into your OppaiMan account and confirm your Supporter registration.
espanol: Um die Datei mit der Statue runterzuladen, logge dich in dein OppaiMan-Konto ein und bestätige deine Supporter-Registrierung.

espanol: Starte das Spiel neu, um die Grafikeinstellungen zu übernehmen

ingles: Tear frames when the game can't keep up with its intended framerate.
espanol: Setzt Frames aus, wenn das Spiel die vorgesehene Framerate nicht einhalten kann.

ingles: lower frame rate to save power.
espanol: Verringere die Bildrate, um Strom zu sparen.

espanol: Während du spielst, kann plötzlich ein Kamin-Symbol auf dem Bildschirm auftauchen.

ingles: When you see it, tap quickly!
espanol: Klick schnell drauf, wenn du es siehst!

ingles: If you click in time, you will receive a collectible card booster.
espanol: Wenn du es rechtzeitig anklickst, kriegst du ein Sammelkarten-Boosterpack.

espanol: Überspringe Text, den du schon im Spiel gesehen hast.

ingles: When turned ON, skipping will resume after a choice
espanol: Wenn eingeschaltet, wird das Überspringen nach einer Auswahl fortgesetzt

ingles: Highlight the best choices in green, helping you easily identify the most optimal decisions as you play.
espanol: Hebe die beste Auswahl in Grün hervor, damit du während des Spiels leicht die optimale Entscheidung treffen kannst.

ingles: This game contains adult content and is intended for mature audiences only.
espanol: Dieses Spiel enthält Inhalte für Erwachsene und ist nur für ein erwachsenes Publikum bestimmt.

ingles: All characters depicted are fictional and over the legal age of 18.
espanol: Alle dargestellten Personen sind fiktiv und über 18 Jahre alt.

espanol: Diese Version des Spiels ist nicht kompatibel zu den Internet-Speicherständen von Season 1.

espanol: Diese zu laden kann zu Fehlern und Abstürzen führen. In solchen Fällen solltest du lieber ein neues Spiel starten.

ingles: Our main character is a curious and inquisitive young man trying to find his way into adulthood as a freshman at Minerva Bay College. As he meets new friends and flirts with all sorts of girls, he does his best to deal with the ghosts of his past.
espanol: Il nostro protagonista è un ragazzo curioso e un po' indiscreto. Frequenta il primo anno del Minerva Bay College, dove incontra nuovi amici e tantissime ragazze diverse con cui provarci mentre tenta di affrontare un duro passato che continua a perseguitarlo.

ingles: Our main character had an accident and lost a good chunk of his recent memories. As he tries to remember his past, he searches for any signs of his father's whereabouts or clues that the people around him were involved in his sudden disappearance.
espanol: È stato coinvolto in un incidente che gli ha fatto perdere parzialmente la memoria. Mentre prova a ricordare il suo passato, cerca indizi su dove si trova suo padre e sulle persone che frequentava nel momento in cui scomparì improvvisamente.

ingles: Lily is married to a man she clearly doesn't love anymore, and she resents herself for it. She sees her own lost youth in our protagonist and starts feeling tempted to relive those glory days and make some different choices.
espanol: Lily prova grande rancore verso se stessa perché è sposata con un uomo che non ama più. Rivede la sua gioventù ormai passata nel protagonista e prova una grande tentazione di rivivere quel periodo d'oro e fare scelte diverse.

ingles: As a young woman, Lily gave up her promising career to build a perfect family with Sam, but her plans didn't turn out like she hoped. Now, with her marriage in tatters, she's trying to decide how to get her life back on track and make up for lost time.
espanol: Ha rinunciato a una carriera promettente per mettere su famiglia con Sam, ma il destino aveva altri piani. Ora il loro matrimonio è in crisi e Lily sta cercando di capire come riavere la sua vita e recuperare il tempo perduto.

ingles: Tough on the outside, sweet on the inside

Sue is a tough, bossy, independent young woman with parents out of the picture and a whole lot of attitude. However, her blunt, standoffish demeanor actually hides a sensitive, empathetic woman who dearly misses her deceased uncle, whom she loved very much.
espanol: Sue è una ragazza forte, indipendente e bacchettona con un bel caratterino. In realtà, i suoi modi bruschi e scostanti celano un'anima empatica e sensibile che pensa spesso al suo defunto zio, a cui voleva un bene immenso.

ingles: Susan's niece, Sue, is a rebellious girl who doesn't get along with her parents. She acts stoic and cold, with some of her words coming off as cruel, but all she wants is someone to truly listen to her.
espanol: Ha un buon rapporto con sua zia Susan, mentre non va d'accordo con i suoi genitori. Si comporta come se fosse una donna stoica e fredda e le sue parole possono sembrare taglienti, ma sotto sotto vorrebbe solo che qualcuno le stia vicino e l'ascolti.

ingles: Chloe is an intelligent and charismatic girl who loves reading and watching science fiction shows like Doctor Who. She loves solving mysteries and can't contain her curiosity when it comes to discovering secrets and scandals surrounding friends and famous people around the city — especially if solving said mystery helps a friend.
espanol: Chloe è una ragazza intelligente e carismatica che adora leggere e guardare serie di fantascienza come Doctor Who. Ama risolvere gli enigmi e ha una curiosità straripante quando si tratta di scoprire segreti e scandali che riguardano amici o persone famose della città... soprattutto se risolvere i suddetti misteri può aiutare un amico.

ingles: She is outgoing and can be quite insistent when she dubs a subject compelling, but she also has a voyeuristic side that she keeps secret, liking to watch people in their most intimate moments.
espanol: È una persona molto estroversa ed estremamente insistente quando parla di un argomento che le piace, ma tiene segreta la sua passione per il voyeurismo e quanto ami guardare le persone nei loro momenti intimi.

ingles: Susan is a college friend of the main character's mother, promising to help the boy when he signed up for school in the big city. She offered him a job and even found him a place to live. But after a closer look, she seems to know a lot about the main character's past, and her evasive manner suggests she's hiding something.
espanol: Susan è un'amica dell'università della madre del protagonista che le promette di aiutare il figlio quando si trasferisce in una grande città, offrendogli un lavoro e un appartamento. Basterà prestare un po' di attenzione, però, per notare che conosce molto bene il passato del protagonista e che sta nascondendo qualcosa con le sue risposte vaghe.

ingles: Susan is a widow without any children, but she has a niece named Sue who also works for her. Susan seems harsh and overbearing, but underneath all that bravado, she's a caring and loving soul who fears she'll never find love again.
espanol: È vedova e senza figli, ma ha una nipote di nome Sue che lavora per lei. Susan sembra una persona severa e prepotente, ma la sua spavalderia è solo una faccia: in realtà, è una donna premurosa e amorevole che ha paura di non trovare mai più l'amore.
Sempre in cerca di guai e divertimento

ingles: Julia is the kind of girl who lights up the room just by being herself — cheerful, sweet, and always ready to jump into something new (especially if that means helping a friend). Whether it be a last-minute road trip or a weekend gaming marathon, she's all in.
espanol: Julia è il tipo di ragazza che illumina la stanza solo con la sua presenza: allegra, dolce e sempre pronta a buttarsi in qualcosa di nuovo (soprattutto se può aiutare un amico). Che si tratti di un viaggio improvvisato o di una maratona di videogiochi nel weekend, lei sarà sempre dei tuoi!

ingles: Playful by nature and curious at heart, she has a soft spot for the unexpected, which includes her more intimate adventures. She never knows exactly where things will lead, and that thrill is half the fun.
espanol: È una persona giocosa e curiosa, infatti ama provare cose inaspettate nelle sue avventure di tutti i giorni, comprese quelle più intime: non sa mai dove la porteranno certe scelte e adora il brivido della scoperta.

ingles: Always cheerful and good-humored, Alyssa is a determined girl with big dreams. During the day, she works as a waitress in a cafe, and at night, she teaches dance. Her dream is to have her own dance studio and form a group to take the stage with her.
espanol: Alyssa è una ragazza determinata, allegra e amabile che ha un grande sogno. Di giorno fa la cameriera a un bar, mentre di notte insegna danza, ma sogna di avere uno studio di ballo tutto suo e fondare un gruppo con cui esibirsi.

ingles: Alyssa works two jobs to help her mother pay the bills and feed two younger brothers. Don't be fooled by her difficulties though; Alyssa is not a girl who sits around complaining. She's always one to find a solution, shooting down each of her problems one by one.
espanol: Alyssa ha due lavori per sostenere la madre e i due fratelli minori. Non aspettarti che si lamenti della sua condizione, però: è una donna forte che affronta i problemi di petto e cerca sempre una soluzione.
Una vicina un po' pazza, ma dalle buone intenzioni

ingles: Emily is a mystery wrapped in an enigma. She seems like an airhead, but then she seems to know more than she's letting on. She gives a sort of dopey and oblivious impression, speaking in a soft tone, but there's something off about her that the main character simply can't explain.
espanol: Emily è un vero e proprio mistero. Sembra che abbia la testa tra le nuvole, ma ogni tanto è chiaro che la sa lunga. Ti dà l'impressione di essere una sciocchina inconsapevole di ciò che accade intorno a lei con la sua voce melliflua, ma nei suoi modi c'è qualcosa che non convince il protagonista.

ingles: Something in the back of the main character's mind whispers that Emily might have something to do with his past, but he can't be sure why. He can't remember anything about her being a part of his life from before.
espanol: Non sa come mai, ma una vocina nella sua testa gli dice che Emily potrebbe avere a che fare con il suo passato. Purtroppo, non ha alcun ricordo di lei.
Una ragazza russa molto, ma molto cattiva

ingles: Devilla and her friend Angela came from Russia, and they're both working as strippers at the bar they own, known as Hell Angels. Devilla is the “bad cop” of the duo, being rather hot-headed and easy to anger. She likes to help, but she's known to ask for something in return. For some reason, she does seem to have a soft spot for our protagonist.
espanol: Devilla e la sua amica Angela sono di origine russa e lavorano entrambe come spogliarelliste al loro locale, Hell Angels. Devilla è \"la poliziotta cattiva\" tra le due, vista la sua tendenza ad arrabbiarsi facilmente. Le piace aiutare le persone, ma tutti sanno che chiede sempre di ricambiare il favore. Non si sa come mai, ma ha un debole per il protagonista.

ingles: Devilla is quite manipulative and knows how to win people over, and she's ready to use all of her skills to transform Hell Angels into the best nightclub in town. Whoever's by her side when that happens better be on good terms with her.
espanol: Devilla è brava a manipolare e persuadere le persone, ed è disposta a tutto per rendere Hell Angels il migliore night club della città. Quando coronerà il suo sogno, è meglio che chiunque sia al suo fianco abbia anche il suo favore.

ingles: Just a good girl from Russia
espanol: Una brava ragazza che viene dalla Russia

ingles: Angela and her friend Devilla came from Russia, and they're both working as strippers at the bar they own, known as Hell Angels. Angela is the “good cop” of the duo, being more sweet and caring — sometimes even seeming a bit naive. However, that's just her way of nudging things toward her desired result.
espanol: Angela e la sua amica Devilla sono di origine russa e lavorano entrambe come spogliarelliste al loro locale, Hell Angels. Devilla è \"la poliziotta buona\" tra le due, essendo più dolce e premurosa... a volte persino un po' ingenua. Tuttavia, è grazie a questo modo di fare che arriva ai risultati che vuole.

ingles: Angela is a skilled entrepreneur, and despite her skills as a stripper, she studies at Minerva Bay College and dreams of turning Hell Angels into the best nightclub in town.
espanol: Angela è un'imprenditrice in gamba: nonostante faccia la spogliarellista, studia al Minerva Bay College e sogna di trasformare Hell Angels nel miglior night club della città.

ingles: Is my class as interesting as my tits?
espanol: La mia lezione è interessante quanto il mio seno?

ingles: Professor Watson is a new hire at Minerva Bay College, teaching economics to the likes of Dylan and the main character. She's known to be mean and likes to tease her students, especially Dylan since he failed her class once before. Still, she has a passion for her subject and her well-endowed bosom.
espanol: La professoressa Watson è una nuova insegnante del Minerva Bay College che insegna economia a Dylan e al protagonista. È famosa per essere un po' cattiva e le piace prendere in giro i suoi studenti, soprattutto Dylan che non ha superato l'esame del suo corso. Nonostante ciò, ama immensamente la materia che insegna e ha anche un seno molto prosperoso.

ingles: Professor Watson is the stereotype of a hot teacher, and she knows it. With her arrogance and self-confidence, she both seduces and intimidates her students, known to make inappropriate and embarrassing comments. Will the main character be able to resist the pressure she brings?
espanol: Questa donna incarna lo stereotipo della professoressa sensuale... e lo sa bene. Sa sedurre e intimidire gli studenti con la sua arroganza e sicurezza e spesso fa commenti inappropriati e imbarazzanti. Il protagonista riuscirà a resistere alla pressione?

ingles: Gabby is the newest lead at Angela and Devilla's bar. She's sweet, kind, and a great listener. She attends the same university as the main character and is terrified that her teachers and the faculty might learn about her side hustle.
espanol: Gabby è la nuova ragazza di punta del locale di Angela e Devilla. È dolce, gentile e una grande ascoltatrice. Frequenta la stessa università del protagonista e ha paura che il corpo docenti scopra il suo lavoro.

ingles: Gabby's dream is to become a famous scientist, but she is willing to do whatever it takes to pay her bills and graduate college —that is, as long as she can be discreet about it and make sure it doesn't ruin her reputation.
espanol: Gabby sogna di diventare una scienziata famosa, ma è disposta a tutto per arrivare a fine mese e laurearsi... basta che la cosa rimanga segreta e non le rovini la reputazione.
Le persone che non fanno domande

ingles: You scratch my back, and I'll scratch yours

Carolyne is a nurse who's been known to take jobs for Fred. She doesn't ask questions and doesn't want to answer any either. She's mysterious and keeps both her past and the circumstances she met Fred under a secret.
espanol: Carolyne è un'infermiera che lavora per Fred. Non fa domande e non vuole nemmeno avere risposte. È una donna misteriosa che non parla mai del suo passato e di come abbia incontrato Fred.

ingles: Carolyne seems to be a trustworthy person, willing to help the main character with his daddy issues. She's charming and confident, seeming to honestly care about the main character's well-being.
espanol: Carolyne è una persona affascinante, affidabile e sicura di sé. Sembra che ci tenga davvero al benessere del protagonista e che sia pronta ad aiutarlo con i problemi legati a suo padre.

ingles: Mae is a regular customer of Susan's. She is a masseuse with a particular interest in the main character after he's tasked with delivering a package to her. Mae is soft-spoken and very eager to get her hands on whatever man comes her way.
espanol: Mae è una cliente abituale di Susan e una massaggiatrice. Dopo che il protagonista le consegna un pacco, sembra mostrare molto interessi nei confronti del ragazzo. È una persona affabile, ma cerca sempre di fare suo qualsiasi uomo le capiti a tiro.

ingles: Mae cares a lot about her looks, so she doesn't look her age even though she's in her forties. She seems to be an influential person in Minerva Bay, and although she's discreet, she seems to take a liking to the younger boys...
espanol: Mae tiene molto al suo aspetto e non dimostra di avere quarant'anni. Sembra essere una persona influente a Minerva Bay e, nonostante la sua riservatezza, pare che abbia un debole per i ragazzi più giovani...

ingles: If life gives you lemons... use them to shoot vodka!
espanol: Se la vita si fa dura, con un po' di vodka passa tutto!

ingles: Dylan is the main character's best friend. He's carefree and always joking — with a flair for the dramatic. Although he talks normally around the main character, Dylan pretends to be Russian around the ladies.
espanol: Dylan è il migliore amico del protagonista. È un ragazzo spensierato e sempre pronto a scherzare... con una tendenza alla teatralità. Parla normalmente col protagonista, ma finge di essere russo di fronte alle ragazze.

ingles: Even though he's somehow managed to hide this big secret from others, Dylan is a great friend that the main character can count on for even the craziest of adventures. He would literally drive across the country to get a friend out of trouble.
espanol: Non si sa come sia riuscito a mantenere questo segreto tanto a lungo. Nonostante questo suo lato curioso, Dylan è un grande amico e il protagonista può contare su di lui per vivere qualsiasi avventura folle: è una di quelle persone disposte a viaggiare da un capo all'altro del mondo per aiutare un amico.

ingles: I'd do anything for my family
espanol: Sarei disposta a tutto per la mia famiglia

ingles: The main character's mother is a loving person, but she can be rather overprotective and seems to know more than she lets on. She can be a bit overbearing, but it's always with the best of intentions.
espanol: La madre del protagonista è una persona amorevole, anche se talvolta risulta un po' iperprotettiva... e sembra essere al corrente di molte più cose di quanto non dica. Ogni tanto si impone un po' troppo, ma agisce sempre a fin di bene.

ingles: Debra loves Fred unconditionally, leaving questions about how complicit she was in Fred's business. Perhaps she really was completely oblivious to everything that happened in the past.
espanol: Debra prova un amore incondizionato nei confronti di Fred e proprio per questo non è chiaro quanto fosse realmente coinvolta nella sua attività. Forse è vero che non sa nulla di quello che è accaduto in passato.

ingles: I have to prove my innocence

Fred is the main character's father. He's been missing for fifteen years after a bad deal went south, leading to his being arrested. He wants to be reunited with his family more than anything else and is willing to do whatever it takes to do so.
espanol: Fred è il padre del protagonista. Per colpa di un brutto affare andato male è scomparso per quindici anni e infine è stato arrestato. Ora vuole solo tornare a vivere con la sua famiglia ed è disposto a tutto pur di realizzare questo desiderio.

ingles: On top of that, Fred seeks revenge against the person he believes to be truly responsible for his fate and will do everything to ensure that the truth about his past is revealed and that the guilty parties are punished.
espanol: Vuole anche vendicarsi della persona che ritiene sia la vera responsabile di ciò che gli è accaduto e farà qualsiasi cosa per far venire a galla la verità sul suo passato e punire i veri responsabili.

ingles: Sam is Lily's husband and the co-owner of a large investment firm. He's possessive and gets angry easily. When he's at his best though, he is an extremely charming man. He did a lot of business with Fred in the past and is one of the prime suspects behind his disappearance.
espanol: Sam è il marito di Lily e il comproprietario di una grande società d'investimento. Quando è di buon umore, è un uomo estremamente affascinante, ma spesso mostra una vena possessiva e un carattere fumantino. Ha fatto affari con Fred in passato ed è uno dei sospetti primari legati alla sua scomparsa.

ingles: After all his investigating, the main character is convinced that Sam is the real villain behind his father's disappearance. But will the main character be able to prove his suspicions?
espanol: Dopo aver condotto diverse ricerche, il protagonista è convinto che è Sam il vero colpevole della scomparsa del padre. Ma riuscirà a dimostrare che i suoi sospetti sono veri?

ingles: Charlie was Susan's husband and a partner of both Fred and Sam. He always stood for what was right in the business, so when things took a turn for the worse, he was quick to turn on his partners. This, in turn, made Fred and Sam resent him.
espanol: Charlie era il marito di Susan e socio di Fred e Sam. Ha sempre deciso di fare la cosa giusta in affari, quindi non ha esitato a voltare le spalle ai suoi partner all'affiorare di alcune complicazioni, portando Fred e Sam a detestarlo.

ingles: Charlie passed away in a traffic accident a few years ago.
espanol: È morto in un incidente stradale qualche anno fa.

ingles: Life is a mole on a chick's ass... You just got to have fun with it!
espanol: La vita è come un neo sul culo di una bella ragazza... l'importante è divertirsi!

ingles: Bruce is a senior at Minerva Bay College and the head of the Sigma-Pi-Nu fraternity. Along with his girlfriend Heather, he organizes parties and other events to welcome the freshmen to campus, enjoying when he can cause mayhem and mischief at the university. The more epic, the better!
espanol: Bruce frequenta l'ultimo anno del Minerva Bay College ed è a capo della confraternita Sigma-Pi-Nu. Organizza feste e altri eventi assieme a Heather, la sua ragazza, per dare il benvenuto alle matricole che arrivano al campus. Ama fare casino e scherzi assurdi.

ingles: Well... let's see what you're capable of.
espanol: Bene... vediamo di cosa sei capace.

ingles: Heather is a senior at Minerva Bay College, and she doesn't seem to like the main character very much. She's Bruce's girlfriend, and she enjoys picking on the freshmen during fraternity events. The main character wants to do everything he can to convince her that he is, in fact, a nice guy who deserves her respect. But will he succeed?
espanol: Heather frequenta l'ultimo anno del Minerva Bay College e non sembra apprezzare molto il protagonista. È la ragazza di Bruce e durante le feste della confraternita si diverte a prendersela con le matricole. Il protagonista cerca di convincerla in ogni modo che è un bravo ragazzo e merita di essere rispettato. Ma ci riuscirà?

ingles: Donna is the vice dean at Minerva Bay College and is currently extremely unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. With her aggressive and uncompromising stance, she vows to combat lewd behavior from her students, known to fight fiercely for morals and righteous behavior.
espanol: Donna è la rettrice associata del Minerva Bay College e al momento non è per niente contenta della dissoluzione che si sta diffondendo nell'ateneo. Da sempre fervida sostenitrice di morale e integrità, ha deciso di opporsi agli atti indecenti degli studenti con fervore e intransigenza.

ingles: When Donna discovers that some university students work and live at a local bar that is home to a number of unbecoming activities, she begins a campaign against the owners.
espanol: Quando Donna scopre che alcuni studenti dell'università lavorano e vivono in un locale notturno in cui succedono cose poco raccomandabili, decide di lanciare una campagna contro le proprietarie.

ingles: Maybe we can solve this with a simple conversation
espanol: Forse possiamo risolvere la questione parlando amabilmente

ingles: Jack is the dean of the university, but his position seems to be under threat from Donna, unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. Jack doesn't seem to be making any effort to maintain morality and righteous behavior within the university. In fact, he might even be taking a few liberties with his power. However, this has left some members of the board less than pleased. Could his position be under threat?
espanol: Jack è il preside dell'università, ma la sua posizione sembra minacciata da Donna, che non è contenta della direzione presa dall'ateneo. Jack non sembra impegnarsi molto per far rispettare la morale e far mantenere comportamenti consoni all'interno dell'università. Anzi, forse si prende qualche libertà sfruttando la sua autorità, cosa che non piace a diversi membri del consiglio. La sua posizione potrebbe essere a rischio?

ingles: This isn't in the rules... but I'll see what I can do.
espanol: Non rispetta il regolamento... ma vedo cosa posso fare.

ingles: Janine works at Minerva Bay College as a secretary. She has a soft spot for Dylan but is otherwise a very conservative person who values 'decency' above all else.
espanol: Janine lavora come segretaria al Minerva Bay College. Ha un debole per Dylan, ma è una persona molto tradizionalista che dà grande valore alla \"decenza\".

ingles: What luck! It must be because the planets are aligned!
espanol: Che fortuna! I pianeti si saranno allineati!

ingles: Jessa is athletic, full of attitude, and has a biting sense of humor. She's a freshman at Minerva Bay College is looking for alternative ways to earn more money to support herself.
espanol: Jessa è una ragazza atletica con un bel caratterino e un umorismo pungente. È una matricola del Minerva Bay College in cerca di un lavoretto per arrivare a fine mese.

ingles: Jessa heard there was a local bar recruiting girls to work there and saw it as a good opportunity to get some extra income. She sees the looks men are always giving her, and she doesn't mind using that to her advantage.
espanol: Ha saputo che un locale del posto sta cercando nuove dipendenti e pensa sia un'ottima opportunità per guadagnare un po' di soldi. Sa benissimo come la guardano gli uomini e non le dispiace sfruttare questa situazione a suo vantaggio.

ingles: This is awkward... but maybe we can work with it.
espanol: È un po' strano... ma forse possiamo ricavarne qualcosa.

ingles: Chery is a shy girl who devotes herself to her studies. Being so intelligent and in her own head all the time, she has a bit of difficulty with social situations... That is, until she received a mysterious proposal about a local bar recruiting girls to work there.
espanol: Chery è una ragazza timida votata allo studio. Oltre a essere estremamente intelligente, ha sempre la testa tra le nuvole, il che non l'aiuta a relazionarsi con gli altri... almeno finché non riceve un'offerta misteriosa da un locale del posto che cerca nuove dipendenti.

ingles: Although Chery was initially uncomfortable with the idea, she eventually reconsidered and accepted the invitation to join Hell Angels. After all, she really needed the extra money...
espanol: Anche se all'inizio Chery non era molto convinta, alla fine ci ha ripensato e ha accettato l'invito a lavorare da Hell Angels. In fondo, aveva davvero bisogno di soldi...

ingles: Oh, I remember you... You're the guy who never showed up!
espanol: Oh, mi ricordo di te... sei quello che non si è mai fatto vivo!

ingles: Madison is Chloe's friend, another member of the book club. the main character doesn't know much about her, but she definitely caught his eye... A fact that she didn't seem to object to.
espanol: Madison è un'amica di Chloe e fa parte del club del libro. Il protagonista non sa molto sul suo conto, ma ha attirato la sua attenzione... cosa che non dispiace a questa ragazza.

ingles: Soft spoken and a good listener
espanol: Una buona ascoltatrice dai modi affabili

ingles: Maybe we can help each other out.

Laura is the police officer who approaches the main character after she opens up an old case linked to the events surrounding Fred and his disappearance. She became a police officer after seeing her father being wronged and forced to pay for a crime he didn't commit.
espanol: Laura è la poliziotta si avvicina al protagonista dopo aver riaperto un vecchio caso legato a Fred e agli eventi che hanno portato alla sua scomparsa. Ha scelto questa carriera dopo che suo padre fu ingannato e obbligato a pagare per un crimine che non aveva commesso.

ingles: Since then, Laura has decided to help people who find themselves in similar situations to hers to prevent others from being wrongfully convicted. She seems quite helpful and persuasive, two qualities that could help her become a strong ally in the main character's search for the truth.
espanol: Da quel momento, Laura decise di aiutare chiunque vivesse una situazione simile alla sua per evitare che altre persone venissero incarcerate erroneamente. È sempre disposta ad aiutare gli altri e ha grandi capacità persuasive, due caratteristiche che potrebbero renderla un'alleata importante per il protagonista, in cerca della verità.

ingles: Tyler is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. He and Claire are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, he shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether he's friend or foe there.
espanol: Tyler è una matricola del Minerva Bay College e frequenta la scuola di ballo di Alyssa. Lui e Claire sono amici d'infanzia e passano ogni istante insieme. Compare come avversario durante la gara delle confraternite, ma non si sa ancora se sia un amico o un nemico.

ingles: Claire is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. She and Tyler are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, she shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether she's friend or foe to the girls there.
espanol: Claire è una matricola del Minerva Bay College che frequenta la scuola di ballo di Alyssa. Lei e Tyler sono amici d'infanzia e passano ogni istante insieme. Compare come avversaria durante la gara delle confraternite, ma non si sa ancora se sia un'amica o una nemica per le ragazze presenti.

ingles: Greg is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competitions. He is tall, strong, and bald. Though that certainly gives him a menacing appearance, the reality is far from it. On the contrary, he's goofy, simple-minded, and borderline cute at times. He dresses like a metalhead and likes to draw. You can see the soul of an artist lurking within.
espanol: Greg è una matricola al Minerva Bay College che partecipa alla gara tra confraternite. È un tipo alto, forte e calvo. Il suo aspetto gli dà un'aria minacciosa, ma in realtà è un ragazzo semplice e talvolta quasi tenero. Si veste come un metallaro e gli piace disegnare, insomma, si vede che ha l'anima di un artista.

ingles: May the force be with me
espanol: Che la Forza sia con me

ingles: Ned is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and although he doesn't seem very threatening, he can be a handful. He's also a huge Science Fiction fan and sometimes dresses up as a Jedi...
espanol: Ned è una matricola del Minerva Bay College che partecipa alla gara tra confraternite. Fa parte della squadra che gareggia contro quella del protagonista e, anche se non sembra una minaccia per la sua vittoria, dà del filo da torcere ai partecipanti. È un grande appassionato di fantascienza e a volte si veste da jedi...

ingles: You'll never gonna beat me, Sigma Boy!
espanol: Non mi batterai mai, sfigato della Sigma!

ingles: Josh is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and every hint leads the main character to believe he'll be trouble. In addition to being a strong competitor, he's singled out the main character as his main rival and wants to make that crystal clear.
espanol: Josh è una matricola del Minerva Bay College che partecipa alla gara delle confraternite nella squadra affrontata dal protagonista. Tutto sembra indicare che questo ragazzo non farà che creare problemi: oltre a dare del filo da torcere nella competizione, Josh ha deciso che il protagonista è il suo acerrimo rivale e le sue azioni lo dimostrano chiaramente.

ingles: Kaylee is Josh's partner during the sorority competitions. We don't know much about her, but she's definitely a freshman at Minerva Bay College... or she wouldn't be competing.
espanol: Kaylee è la compagna di Josh per le competizioni delle confraternite. Non si sa molto sul suo conto, escluso il fatto che è una matricola del Minerva Bay College... altrimenti non parteciperebbe alle gare.

ingles: He's the bouncer at Hell Angels, a local bar. We don't know much about him... After all, he's not much of a talker.
espanol: È il buttafuori di Hell Angels, un locale del posto. Non sappiamo molto di lui... in fondo, non è un gran chiacchierone.

ingles: With thanks, a gift for you

As a thank you to everyone who continues to believe in our project and chose to support the game by purchasing the Supporter Pack, we've prepared a special gift: an exclusive 3D-printable file for a figurine of Julia.
espanol: Abbiamo preparato un regalo speciale per tutte le persone che continuano a credere nel nostro progetto e hanno deciso di supportare il gioco comprando la Supporter Edition, ovvero un esclusivo file per la stampa in 3D di una statuetta di Julia.

ingles: This gift is more than just a digital item — it's a symbol of appreciation for those who helped make the game possible. We designed this statue for the fans who truly care about the world we're building and want to bring a piece of it into their own homes.
espanol: Questo regalo non è solo un oggetto digitale, ma anche un modo per ringraziare chi ha reso possibile creare il nostro gioco. Abbiamo realizzato questa statuetta per i fan che ci tengono davvero all'universo che stiamo costruendo e vogliono portare un pezzetto di questo mondo nelle loro case.

ingles: We know that supporting a game is an act of trust and passion, and this small tribute is our way of giving something meaningful back — something personal, unique, and made to be proudly displayed.
espanol: Sappiamo che sostenere un gioco è un atto di fiducia e passione e questo omaggio è un modo per ripagare il tuo gesto con qualcosa di personale e unico, da mostrare a tutti con orgoglio.

ingles: To download the statue file, log into your OppaiMan account and confirm your Supporter registration.
espanol: Per scaricare il file della statuetta, accedi al tuo account OppaiMan e conferma la tua registrazione come sostenitore.
