ingles: Don't forget to save your progress
This game supports a self-voicing mode in which a speech synthesizer is used to read out text and other interface elements, this is intended to make accessible to the vision impaired.
espanol: Ta gra posiada tryb syntezatora mowy, w którym odczytuje on tekst i inne elementy interfejsu. Ma to na celu ułatwienie dostępu do gry osobom z wadą wzroku.

ingles: Our main character is a curious and inquisitive young man trying to find his way into adulthood as a freshman at Minerva Bay College. As he meets new friends and flirts with all sorts of girls, he does his best to deal with the ghosts of his past.
espanol: Nasz główny bohater to ciekawy świata i dociekliwy chłopak, który próbuje prowadzić niezależne dorosłe życie jako student pierwszego roku na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay. Spotyka tam nowych przyjaciół i flirtuje z wieloma dziewczynami, ale stara się też uporać z demonami ze swojej przeszłości.

ingles: Our main character had an accident and lost a good chunk of his recent memories. As he tries to remember his past, he searches for any signs of his father's whereabouts or clues that the people around him were involved in his sudden disappearance.
espanol: Nasz główny bohater miał wypadek, przez który stracił znaczną część swoich wspomnień. Stara się przypomnieć sobie swoją przeszłość i szuka swojego ojca oraz wskazówek dotyczących tego, którzy ludzie w jego otoczeniu mieli jakiś związek z jego zaginięciem.

ingles: Lily is married to a man she clearly doesn't love anymore, and she resents herself for it. She sees her own lost youth in our protagonist and starts feeling tempted to relive those glory days and make some different choices.
espanol: Lily jest żoną mężczyzny, którego wyraźnie już nie kocha, i nienawidzi się przez to. Główny bohater przypomina jej o utraconej młodości, przez co budzi się w niej pragnienie powrócenia do tamtych dni i podjęcia innych decyzji.

ingles: As a young woman, Lily gave up her promising career to build a perfect family with Sam, but her plans didn't turn out like she hoped. Now, with her marriage in tatters, she's trying to decide how to get her life back on track and make up for lost time.
espanol: Za młodu Lily zrezygnowała z obiecującej kariery, by stworzyć z Samem idealną rodzinę, ale sprawy nie potoczyły się tak, jak planowała. Teraz, gdy jej małżeństwo się rozpada, zdecydowała, że naprawi swoje życie i nadrobi stracony czas.

ingles: Tough on the outside, sweet on the inside
espanol: Wygląda na twardą, ale ma miękkie serce

ingles: Sue is a tough, bossy, independent young woman with parents out of the picture and a whole lot of attitude. However, her blunt, standoffish demeanor actually hides a sensitive, empathetic woman who dearly misses her deceased uncle, whom she loved very much.
espanol: Sue to twarda, apodyktyczna i niezależna młoda kobieta, która ma słaby kontakt z rodzicami i bardzo trudny charakter. Jednak jej ostre, agresywne zachowanie to tylko tarcza, za którą kryje się wrażliwa i empatyczna dziewczyna, która bardzo tęskni za swoim ukochanym zmarłym wujkiem.

ingles: Susan's niece, Sue, is a rebellious girl who doesn't get along with her parents. She acts stoic and cold, with some of her words coming off as cruel, but all she wants is someone to truly listen to her.
espanol: Siostrzenica Susan, Sue, to zbuntowana dziewczyna, która nie dogaduje się z rodzicami. Udaje zimną i stoicką, czasem sprawia wrażenie okrutnej, ale jedyne, czego chce, to by ktoś jej wysłuchał.

ingles: Chloe is an intelligent and charismatic girl who loves reading and watching science fiction shows like Doctor Who. She loves solving mysteries and can't contain her curiosity when it comes to discovering secrets and scandals surrounding friends and famous people around the city — especially if solving said mystery helps a friend.
espanol: Chloe to inteligentna i charyzmatyczna dziewczyna, która kocha czytać książki i oglądać seriale science fiction, takie jak Doktor Who. Uwielbia rozwiązywanie zagadek i nie potrafi powstrzymać swojej ciekawości, jeśli chodzi o odkrywanie sekretów i skandali powiązanych z jej przyjaciółmi i sławnymi ludźmi z całego miasta – szczególnie, jeśli rozwiązanie takiej zagadki pomoże któremuś z jej przyjaciół.

ingles: She is outgoing and can be quite insistent when she dubs a subject compelling, but she also has a voyeuristic side that she keeps secret, liking to watch people in their most intimate moments.
espanol: Jest bardzo otwarta i potrafi być nieco namolna, gdy ktoś ją zafascynuje, ale ma również pewien sekret: lubi podglądać ludzi w ich intymnych momentach.

ingles: Susan is a college friend of the main character's mother, promising to help the boy when he signed up for school in the big city. She offered him a job and even found him a place to live. But after a closer look, she seems to know a lot about the main character's past, and her evasive manner suggests she's hiding something.
espanol: Susan jest koleżanką ze studiów matki głównego bohatera. Obiecała, że pomoże mu, gdy dostał się na uczelnię w wielkim mieście. Zaoferowała mu pracę, a nawet znalazła mieszkanie. Ale zdaje się, że wie bardzo dużo o jego przeszłości i prawdopodobnie coś przed nim ukrywa.

ingles: Susan is a widow without any children, but she has a niece named Sue who also works for her. Susan seems harsh and overbearing, but underneath all that bravado, she's a caring and loving soul who fears she'll never find love again.
espanol: Susan to bezdzietna wdowa mieszkająca ze swoją bratanicą Sue, która dla niej pracuje. Choć na pierwszy rzut oka sprawia wrażenie surowej i apodyktycznej, tak naprawdę jest troskliwą kobietą, która boi się, że nigdy już się nie zakocha.

ingles: Julia is the kind of girl who lights up the room just by being herself — cheerful, sweet, and always ready to jump into something new (especially if that means helping a friend). Whether it be a last-minute road trip or a weekend gaming marathon, she's all in.
espanol: Julia to dziewczyna, która potrafi rozświetlić każde pomieszczenie swoją obecnością – jest słodka, pogodna i zawsze gotowa, by zabrać się za coś nowego (szczególnie, jeśli pomoże to któremuś z jej przyjaciół). Nieważne, czy chodzi o spontaniczny wypad gdzieś, czy o weekendowy maraton gier, z pewnością nie odmówi.

ingles: Playful by nature and curious at heart, she has a soft spot for the unexpected, which includes her more intimate adventures. She never knows exactly where things will lead, and that thrill is half the fun.
espanol: Z natury pogodna i ciekawa świata, lubi to, co nieoczekiwane, również w sypialni. Nigdy nie wie dokładnie, gdzie ją to zaprowadzi, co bardzo ją ekscytuje.

ingles: Always cheerful and good-humored, Alyssa is a determined girl with big dreams. During the day, she works as a waitress in a cafe, and at night, she teaches dance. Her dream is to have her own dance studio and form a group to take the stage with her.
espanol: Zawsze radosna i pozytywnie nastawiona, Alyssa to pełna determinacji dziewczyna o dużych ambicjach. Za dnia pracuje w kawiarni jako kelnerka, a wieczorami uczy tańca. Marzy o posiadaniu własnego studia i stworzeniu zespołu tanecznego, z którym mogłaby występować.

ingles: Alyssa works two jobs to help her mother pay the bills and feed two younger brothers. Don't be fooled by her difficulties though; Alyssa is not a girl who sits around complaining. She's always one to find a solution, shooting down each of her problems one by one.
espanol: Alyssa pracuje na dwa etaty, by pomóc mamie opłacić rachunki i wyżywić swoich młodszych braci. Niech cię to jednak nie zwiedzie: to nie jest ktoś, kto ciągle narzeka na swoją trudną sytuację. Zawsze znajduje jakieś rozwiązanie, po kolei radząc sobie z każdym problemem.

ingles: Emily is a mystery wrapped in an enigma. She seems like an airhead, but then she seems to know more than she's letting on. She gives a sort of dopey and oblivious impression, speaking in a soft tone, but there's something off about her that the main character simply can't explain.
espanol: Emily jest niezwykle zagadkową osobą. Czasem wydaje się nieco głupiutka, ale wyraźnie wie więcej, niż daje po sobie poznać. Sprawia wrażenie naiwnej i łagodnej, ale ma w sobie coś, czego główny bohater nie jest w stanie wytłumaczyć.

ingles: Something in the back of the main character's mind whispers that Emily might have something to do with his past, but he can't be sure why. He can't remember anything about her being a part of his life from before.
espanol: Coś podpowiada głównemu bohaterowi, że Emily mogła odgrywać jakąś rolę w jego przeszłości, ale nie wie, czemu. Nie pamięta o niej absolutnie nic.

ingles: Devilla and her friend Angela came from Russia, and they're both working as strippers at the bar they own, known as Hell Angels. Devilla is the “bad cop” of the duo, being rather hot-headed and easy to anger. She likes to help, but she's known to ask for something in return. For some reason, she does seem to have a soft spot for our protagonist.
espanol: Devilla i jej przyjaciółka Angela przybyły do Stanów z Rosji. Obie pracują jako striptizerki w należącym do nich barze o nazwie Diablice. Devilla jest w tym duecie „złym gliną”, ponieważ jest dość porywcza. Lubi pomagać innym, ale znana jest z tego, że oczekuje czegoś w zamian. Z jakiejś przyczyny zdaje się mieć słabość do głównego bohatera.

ingles: Devilla is quite manipulative and knows how to win people over, and she's ready to use all of her skills to transform Hell Angels into the best nightclub in town. Whoever's by her side when that happens better be on good terms with her.
espanol: Devilla jest dość podstępna i umie zjednywać sobie ludzi, co zamierza wykorzystać, by zmienić Diablice w najlepszy klub w mieście. Ci, którzy planują być wówczas u jej boku, powinni postarać się, by być z nią w dobrych stosunkach.

ingles: Just a good girl from Russia

Angela and her friend Devilla came from Russia, and they're both working as strippers at the bar they own, known as Hell Angels. Angela is the “good cop” of the duo, being more sweet and caring — sometimes even seeming a bit naive. However, that's just her way of nudging things toward her desired result.
espanol: Angela i jej przyjaciółka Devilla przybyły do Stanów z Rosji. Obie pracują jako striptizerki w należącym do nich barze o nazwie Diablice. Angela jest w tym duecie „dobrym gliną”, ponieważ jest słodka i empatyczna – czasem wydaje się wręcz nieco naiwna. Jednak to tylko jej sposób na osiąganie pożądanych rezultatów.

ingles: Angela is a skilled entrepreneur, and despite her skills as a stripper, she studies at Minerva Bay College and dreams of turning Hell Angels into the best nightclub in town.
espanol: Angela to utalentowana kobieta biznesu, i choć jest striptizerką, studiuje również na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay i marzy o tym, by Diablice stały się najlepszym klubem nocnym w mieście.

ingles: Is my class as interesting as my tits?
espanol: Czy moje zajęcia są równie ciekawe, co moje cycki?

ingles: Professor Watson is a new hire at Minerva Bay College, teaching economics to the likes of Dylan and the main character. She's known to be mean and likes to tease her students, especially Dylan since he failed her class once before. Still, she has a passion for her subject and her well-endowed bosom.
espanol: Profesor Watson to nowa wykładowczyni na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay. Prowadzi zajęcia z ekonomii dla studentów takich jak Dylan i główny bohater. Znana jest ze złośliwości i zamiłowania do zaczepiania swoich studentów, szczególnie Dylana, który raz już nie zaliczył jej przedmiotu. Uwielbia ekonomię i swoje wielkie piersi.

ingles: Professor Watson is the stereotype of a hot teacher, and she knows it. With her arrogance and self-confidence, she both seduces and intimidates her students, known to make inappropriate and embarrassing comments. Will the main character be able to resist the pressure she brings?
espanol: Profesor Watson to stereotypowa seksowna nauczycielka i jest tego w pełni świadoma. Jej pewność siebie i arogancja pomagają jej uwieść i onieśmielić studentów. Znana jest z niestosownych i krępujących komentarzy. Czy główny bohater będzie w stanie oprzeć się wywieranej przez nią presji?

ingles: Gabby is the newest lead at Angela and Devilla's bar. She's sweet, kind, and a great listener. She attends the same university as the main character and is terrified that her teachers and the faculty might learn about her side hustle.
espanol: Gabby to najnowsza gwiazda baru Angeli i Devilli. Jest miła, urocza i zawsze gotowa wysłuchać swoich przyjaciół. Studiuje na tej samej uczelni co główny bohater i bardzo się boi, że jej wykładowcy odkryją, jak zarabia na życie.

ingles: Gabby's dream is to become a famous scientist, but she is willing to do whatever it takes to pay her bills and graduate college —that is, as long as she can be discreet about it and make sure it doesn't ruin her reputation.
espanol: Gabby marzy o zostaniu słynną badaczką i zrobi wszystko, by zarobić na czesne – ale stara się zachować dyskrecję i zapewnić, że nie zniszczy swojej reputacji.

ingles: You scratch my back, and I'll scratch yours
espanol: Ty pomożesz mnie, a ja tobie

ingles: Carolyne is a nurse who's been known to take jobs for Fred. She doesn't ask questions and doesn't want to answer any either. She's mysterious and keeps both her past and the circumstances she met Fred under a secret.
espanol: Carolyne jest pielęgniarką, która często przyjmuje zlecenia od Freda. Nie zadaje pytań i sama również nie chce na żadne odpowiadać. Jest tajemnicza i nie chce zdradzić nic o swojej przeszłości ani o tym, jak poznała Freda.

ingles: Carolyne seems to be a trustworthy person, willing to help the main character with his daddy issues. She's charming and confident, seeming to honestly care about the main character's well-being.
espanol: Carolyne zdaje się być godną zaufania osobą, gotową pomóc głównemu bohaterowi naprawić swoją trudną relację z ojcem. Jest czarująca i pewna siebie, i naprawdę dobrze życzy głównemu bohaterowi.

ingles: Mae is a regular customer of Susan's. She is a masseuse with a particular interest in the main character after he's tasked with delivering a package to her. Mae is soft-spoken and very eager to get her hands on whatever man comes her way.
espanol: Mae jest stałą klientką Susan. Z zawodu jest masażystką i wykazuje szczególne zainteresowanie głównym bohaterem, po tym, jak dostarczył jej on paczkę. To cicha kobieta, która pragnie zdobyć każdego mężczyznę, który stanie na jej drodze.

ingles: Mae cares a lot about her looks, so she doesn't look her age even though she's in her forties. She seems to be an influential person in Minerva Bay, and although she's discreet, she seems to take a liking to the younger boys...
espanol: Mae bardzo dba o swój wygląd, więc nie wygląda na swój wiek, mimo że jest już po czterdziestce. Wydaje się być jedną z bardziej wpływowych osób w Minerva Bay i choć jest dyskretna, zdaje się, że lubi młodszych mężczyzn...

ingles: If life gives you lemons... use them to shoot vodka!
espanol: Gdy los daje ci cytryny... użyj ich do shotów wódki!

ingles: Dylan is the main character's best friend. He's carefree and always joking — with a flair for the dramatic. Although he talks normally around the main character, Dylan pretends to be Russian around the ladies.
espanol: Dylan to przyjaciel głównego bohatera. To beztroski facet, który kocha sobie żartować i ma tendencję do dramatyzowania. Rozmawiając z głównym bohaterem zachowuje się normalnie, ale przy dziewczynach udaje Rosjanina.

ingles: Even though he's somehow managed to hide this big secret from others, Dylan is a great friend that the main character can count on for even the craziest of adventures. He would literally drive across the country to get a friend out of trouble.
espanol: Choć jakimś sposobem udaje mu się utrzymywać w tajemnicy swoją prawdziwą narodowość, Dylan to świetny kumpel, na którego główny bohater może liczyć nawet podczas najbardziej szalonych przygód. Jest gotów dosłownie przejechać pół kraju, by wyciągnąć przyjaciela z tarapatów.

ingles: I'd do anything for my family

The main character's mother is a loving person, but she can be rather overprotective and seems to know more than she lets on. She can be a bit overbearing, but it's always with the best of intentions.
espanol: Matka głównego bohatera jest troskliwa, ale bywa też nieco nadopiekuńcza i zdaje się wiedzieć więcej niż twierdzi. Czasami trochę przesadza, ale zawsze ma dobre intencje.

ingles: Debra loves Fred unconditionally, leaving questions about how complicit she was in Fred's business. Perhaps she really was completely oblivious to everything that happened in the past.
espanol: Debra bezwarunkowo kocha Freda, co sprawia, że można się zastanawiać, czy nie była aby zamieszana w jego podejrzane interesy. Może jednak faktycznie nie miała pojęcia, co się wydarzyło te lata temu.

ingles: I have to prove my innocence

Fred is the main character's father. He's been missing for fifteen years after a bad deal went south, leading to his being arrested. He wants to be reunited with his family more than anything else and is willing to do whatever it takes to do so.
espanol: Fred jest ojcem głównego bohatera. Piętnaście lat temu, po tym, jak wpakował się w podejrzane interesy, zniknął z jego życia i został aresztowany. Jego najgorętszym pragnieniem jest powrót do rodziny i zrobi, co w jego mocy, by to osiągnąć.

ingles: On top of that, Fred seeks revenge against the person he believes to be truly responsible for his fate and will do everything to ensure that the truth about his past is revealed and that the guilty parties are punished.
espanol: Ponadto Fred pragnie zemścić się na człowieku, którego uważa za winnego losu, który go spotkał, i zrobi wszystko, by ujawnić prawdę o swojej przeszłości i doprowadzić do ukarania winnych.
Tak już jest w tym biznesie

ingles: Sam is Lily's husband and the co-owner of a large investment firm. He's possessive and gets angry easily. When he's at his best though, he is an extremely charming man. He did a lot of business with Fred in the past and is one of the prime suspects behind his disappearance.
espanol: Sam jest mężem Lily i współwłaścicielem wielkiej firmy inwestycyjnej. Jest zaborczy i skory do gniewu. Jednak gdy jest w dobrym humorze, potrafi być naprawdę czarujący. Lata temu robił wiele interesów z Fredem i jest jednym z głównych podejrzanych w sprawie jego zniknięcia.

ingles: After all his investigating, the main character is convinced that Sam is the real villain behind his father's disappearance. But will the main character be able to prove his suspicions?
espanol: Po długim śledztwie główny bohater jest przekonany, że to Sam stoi za zniknięciem jego ojca. Ale czy uda mu się to udowodnić?

ingles: Charlie was Susan's husband and a partner of both Fred and Sam. He always stood for what was right in the business, so when things took a turn for the worse, he was quick to turn on his partners. This, in turn, made Fred and Sam resent him.
espanol: Charlie był mężem Susan i wspólnikiem Freda i Sama. W interesach zawsze opowiadał się za tym, co słuszne, więc gdy sytuacja zaczęła robić się podejrzana, zwrócił się przeciwko swoim wspólnikom. To sprawiło, że Fred i Sam zaczęli czuć wobec niego urazę.

ingles: Charlie passed away in a traffic accident a few years ago.
espanol: Charlie zginął w wypadku samochodowym kilka lat temu.

ingles: Life is a mole on a chick's ass... You just got to have fun with it!
espanol: Życie jest jak pieprzyk na tyłku twojej laski... Trzeba się nim cieszyć!

ingles: Bruce is a senior at Minerva Bay College and the head of the Sigma-Pi-Nu fraternity. Along with his girlfriend Heather, he organizes parties and other events to welcome the freshmen to campus, enjoying when he can cause mayhem and mischief at the university. The more epic, the better!
espanol: Bruce jest na ostatnim roku studiów na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay i pełni funkcję przewodniczącego bractwa Sigma-Pi-Nu. Razem ze swoją dziewczyną, Heather, organizują imprezy i inne wydarzenia, by powitać studentów pierwszego roku na kampusie. Lubi szaleć i siać chaos na uczelni. Byleby było epicko!

ingles: Well... let's see what you're capable of.

Heather is a senior at Minerva Bay College, and she doesn't seem to like the main character very much. She's Bruce's girlfriend, and she enjoys picking on the freshmen during fraternity events. The main character wants to do everything he can to convince her that he is, in fact, a nice guy who deserves her respect. But will he succeed?
espanol: Heather jest studentką ostatniego roku na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay i chyba nie przepada za głównym bohaterem. Jest dziewczyną Bruce'a i lubi gnębić studentów pierwszego roku na imprezach bractwa. Główny bohater chce dać z siebie wszystko, by przekonać ją, że jest miłym gościem, który zasługuje na szacunek. Ale czy mu się uda?

ingles: Donna is the vice dean at Minerva Bay College and is currently extremely unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. With her aggressive and uncompromising stance, she vows to combat lewd behavior from her students, known to fight fiercely for morals and righteous behavior.
espanol: Donna jest prodziekanem uniwersytetu w Minerva Bay i jest bardzo niezadowolona z tego, jak perwersyjna atmosfera tam panuje. W agresywny i bezkompromisowy sposób podejmuje się walki z nieprzyzwoitym zachowaniem swoich studentów. Będzie dawać z siebie wszystko w imię moralności i praworządności.

ingles: When Donna discovers that some university students work and live at a local bar that is home to a number of unbecoming activities, she begins a campaign against the owners.
espanol: Gdy Donna odkrywa, że niektórzy studenci jej uczelni pracują i mieszkają w pewnym cieszącym się złą sławą barze, rozpoczyna kampanię przeciwko jego właścicielkom.

ingles: Maybe we can solve this with a simple conversation
espanol: Może będziemy w stanie rozwiązać ten problem rozmową

ingles: Jack is the dean of the university, but his position seems to be under threat from Donna, unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. Jack doesn't seem to be making any effort to maintain morality and righteous behavior within the university. In fact, he might even be taking a few liberties with his power. However, this has left some members of the board less than pleased. Could his position be under threat?
espanol: Jack jest dziekanem uczelni, ale jego pozycja zdaje się być zagrożona ze względu na Donnę, niezadowoloną z panującej perwersyjnej atmosfery. Nie stara się specjalnie, by pilnować przestrzegania norm moralnych. Wręcz przeciwnie, zdarza mu się nawet niestosownie wykorzystywać swoje wpływy. Sprawia to jednak, że niektórzy członkowie rady wydziału nie są zachwyceni. Czy czekają go nieprzyjemne konsekwencje?

ingles: This isn't in the rules... but I'll see what I can do.
espanol: Tego nie ma w regulaminie... ale zobaczę, co da się zrobić.

ingles: Janine works at Minerva Bay College as a secretary. She has a soft spot for Dylan but is otherwise a very conservative person who values 'decency' above all else.
espanol: Janine jest sekretarką na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay. Ma słabość do Dylana, ale poza tym jest bardzo konserwatywną osobą, która ponad wszystko ceni przyzwoitość.

ingles: What luck! It must be because the planets are aligned!
espanol: Co za szczęście! To na pewno dzięki sprzyjającemu układowi planet!

ingles: Jessa is athletic, full of attitude, and has a biting sense of humor. She's a freshman at Minerva Bay College is looking for alternative ways to earn more money to support herself.
espanol: Jessa jest wysportowana, pełna energii i obdarzona ostrym poczuciem humoru. Studiuje na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay i szuka dodatkowego sposobu, by zarobić na swoje utrzymanie.

ingles: Jessa heard there was a local bar recruiting girls to work there and saw it as a good opportunity to get some extra income. She sees the looks men are always giving her, and she doesn't mind using that to her advantage.
espanol: Słyszała, że lokalny bar szuka dziewczyn do pracy i uznała, że to dobra okazja, by sobie trochę dorobić. Widzi, jak mężczyźni na nią patrzą i nie ma nic przeciwko temu, by to wykorzystywać.

ingles: This is awkward... but maybe we can work with it.
espanol: Niezręczna sytuacja... ale może jakoś damy sobie radę.

ingles: Chery is a shy girl who devotes herself to her studies. Being so intelligent and in her own head all the time, she has a bit of difficulty with social situations... That is, until she received a mysterious proposal about a local bar recruiting girls to work there.
espanol: Chery to nieśmiała dziewczyna, która bardzo pilnie się uczy. Jest inteligentna i żyje w swoim własnym świecie, przez co kontakty z innymi ludźmi sprawiają jej trudności... Do czasu, gdy otrzymuje intrygującą propozycję z lokalnego baru rekrutującego dziewczyny do pracy.

ingles: Although Chery was initially uncomfortable with the idea, she eventually reconsidered and accepted the invitation to join Hell Angels. After all, she really needed the extra money...
espanol: Choć początkowo nie podobał jej się ten pomysł, przemyślała to i ostatecznie dołączyła do Diablic. W końcu naprawdę przydadzą jej się te pieniądze...

ingles: Oh, I remember you... You're the guy who never showed up!
espanol: O, pamiętam cię... Jesteś tym chłopakiem, który nigdy nie przychodzi!

ingles: Madison is Chloe's friend, another member of the book club. the main character doesn't know much about her, but she definitely caught his eye... A fact that she didn't seem to object to.
espanol: Madison jest przyjaciółką Chloe i również należy do klubu książki. Główny bohater niewiele o niej wie, ale wpadła mu w oko... I zdaje się nie mieć z tym problemu.

ingles: Soft spoken and a good listener
Maybe we can help each other out.

Laura is the police officer who approaches the main character after she opens up an old case linked to the events surrounding Fred and his disappearance. She became a police officer after seeing her father being wronged and forced to pay for a crime he didn't commit.
espanol: Laura to policjantka, która skontaktowała się z głównym bohaterem po tym, jak przydzielono ją do sprawy dotyczącej Freda i jego zniknięcia. Zdecydowała o dołączeniu do policji po tym, jak jej ojciec został pokrzywdzony przez wymiar sprawiedliwości i ukarany za coś, czego nie zrobił.

ingles: Since then, Laura has decided to help people who find themselves in similar situations to hers to prevent others from being wrongfully convicted. She seems quite helpful and persuasive, two qualities that could help her become a strong ally in the main character's search for the truth.
espanol: Od tamtego momentu Laura postanowiła pomagać ludziom, którzy znaleźli się w podobnej sytuacji, by nie zostali niesłusznie skazani. Zdaje się być pomocną i przekonującą osobą, co potencjalnie czyni ją ważną sojuszniczką głównego bohatera.

ingles: Tyler is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. He and Claire are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, he shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether he's friend or foe there.
espanol: Tyler jest studentem pierwszego roku na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay, uczęszczającym również na kurs tańca Alyssy. On i Claire są przyjaciółmi od dziecka i wszędzie chodzą razem. Bierze udział w zawodach bractwa, ale dopiero okaże się, czy będzie sojusznikiem, czy przeciwnikiem.

ingles: Claire is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. She and Tyler are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, she shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether she's friend or foe to the girls there.
espanol: Claire to studentka pierwszego roku na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay, uczęszczająca również na kurs tańca Alyssy. Ona i Tyler są przyjaciółmi od dziecka i wszędzie chodzą razem. Bierze udział w zawodach bractwa, ale dopiero okaże się, czy będzie sojuszniczką, czy przeciwniczką.

ingles: Greg is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competitions. He is tall, strong, and bald. Though that certainly gives him a menacing appearance, the reality is far from it. On the contrary, he's goofy, simple-minded, and borderline cute at times. He dresses like a metalhead and likes to draw. You can see the soul of an artist lurking within.
espanol: Greg jest biorącym udział w zawodach bractwa studentem pierwszego roku na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay. Jest wysoki, silny i łysy, przez co sprawia groźne wrażenie, ale tak naprawdę to nieskomplikowany facet, który lubi się wygłupiać i bywa naprawdę uroczy. Ubiera się jak metal i lubi malować. Ma duszę artysty.

ingles: May the force be with me

Ned is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and although he doesn't seem very threatening, he can be a handful. He's also a huge Science Fiction fan and sometimes dresses up as a Jedi...
espanol: Ned jest biorącym udział w zawodach bractwa studentem pierwszego roku na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay. Jest w drużynie konkurującej z drużyną głównego bohatera i choć nie wydaje się być poważnym zagrożeniem, potrafi być męczący. Jest wielkim fanem science fiction i czasem przebiera się za Jedi...

ingles: You'll never gonna beat me, Sigma Boy!
espanol: Nie pokonasz mnie, chłopczyku z Sigmy!

ingles: Josh is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and every hint leads the main character to believe he'll be trouble. In addition to being a strong competitor, he's singled out the main character as his main rival and wants to make that crystal clear.
espanol: Josh jest biorącym udział w zawodach bractwa studentem pierwszego roku na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay. Jest w drużynie konkurującej z drużyną głównego bohatera i zdecydowanie widać, że będzie sprawiał problemy. Jest silnym przeciwnikiem, a ponadto zdecydował, że główny bohater jest jego największym rywalem i nie ukrywa tego.

ingles: Kaylee is Josh's partner during the sorority competitions. We don't know much about her, but she's definitely a freshman at Minerva Bay College... or she wouldn't be competing.
espanol: Kaylee jest partnerką Josha w zawodach bractw studenckich. Niewiele o niej wiemy, ale z pewnością jest studentką pierwszego roku na uniwersytecie w Minerva Bay... albo nie mogłaby brać udziału w tych zawodach.

ingles: He's the bouncer at Hell Angels, a local bar. We don't know much about him... After all, he's not much of a talker.
espanol: Ochroniarz w barze Diablice. Niewiele o nim wiemy... Nie jest zbyt rozmowny.

ingles: With thanks, a gift for you

As a thank you to everyone who continues to believe in our project and chose to support the game by purchasing the Supporter Pack, we've prepared a special gift: an exclusive 3D-printable file for a figurine of Julia.
espanol: W ramach podziękowania dla wszystkich, którzy wierzą w nasz projekt i zdecydowali się nas wesprzeć, kupując Pakiet Wspierającego, przygotowaliśmy specjalny prezent, wyjątkową statuetkę Julii do druku 3D.

ingles: This gift is more than just a digital item — it's a symbol of appreciation for those who helped make the game possible. We designed this statue for the fans who truly care about the world we're building and want to bring a piece of it into their own homes.
espanol: Ten prezent to coś więcej niż tylko zwykły plik – to dowód naszej wdzięczności wobec graczy, którzy sprawili, że ta gra mogła powstać. Zaprojektowaliśmy tę statuetkę dla tych z was, którzy naprawdę kochają stworzony przez nas świat i chcą mieć jego namiastkę w swoich domach.

ingles: We know that supporting a game is an act of trust and passion, and this small tribute is our way of giving something meaningful back — something personal, unique, and made to be proudly displayed.
espanol: Wiemy, że wspieranie gry to dowód zaufania i pasji, a ten mały podarunek to sposób, by się wam odwdzięczyć — coś od serca, wyjątkowego, i czym możecie się z dumą chwalić.

ingles: To download the statue file, log into your OppaiMan account and confirm your Supporter registration.
espanol: By pobrać plik ze statuetką, zaloguj się na swoje konto OppaiMan i potwierdź bycie zarejestrowanym Wspierającym.

If you click in time, you will receive a collectible card booster.

Pokaż, która opcja do wyboru jest najlepsza

ingles: Highlight the best choices in green, helping you easily identify the most optimal decisions as you play.
espanol: Podświetla na zielono najlepsze opcje do wyboru, co pomoże ci łatwo identyfikować optymalne decyzje w trakcie gry.

ingles: This game supports a self-voicing mode in which a speech synthesizer is used to read out text and other interface elements, this is intended to make accessible to the vision impaired.
espanol: Esse jogo tem um modo de voz automática, que usa um sintetizador de voz pra ler o texto e outros elementos da interface. Isso foi feito pra tornar o jogo acessível pra quem tem deficiência visual.

ingles: Our main character is a curious and inquisitive young man trying to find his way into adulthood as a freshman at Minerva Bay College. As he meets new friends and flirts with all sorts of girls, he does his best to deal with the ghosts of his past.
espanol: Nosso protagonista é um jovem curioso e questionador que tá tentando encontrar seu caminho na vida adulta como calouro na Minerva Bay College. Enquanto faz novos amigos e dá em cima de todo tipo de garota, ele faz o possível pra lidar com os fantasmas do seu passado.

ingles: Our main character had an accident and lost a good chunk of his recent memories. As he tries to remember his past, he searches for any signs of his father's whereabouts or clues that the people around him were involved in his sudden disappearance.
espanol: Nosso personagem principal sofreu um acidente e perdeu boa parte das suas memórias recentes. Enquanto tenta lembrar do seu passado, ele procura por qualquer sinal do seu pai ou pistas que indiquem que as pessoas ao seu redor estão envolvidas no seu desaparecimento repentino.

ingles: Lily is married to a man she clearly doesn't love anymore, and she resents herself for it. She sees her own lost youth in our protagonist and starts feeling tempted to relive those glory days and make some different choices.
espanol: Lily é casada com um cara que ela claramente não ama mais, e ela se culpa por isso. Ela vê a própria juventude perdida na nossa protagonista e começa a sentir vontade de reviver aqueles dias de glória e fazer escolhas diferentes.

ingles: As a young woman, Lily gave up her promising career to build a perfect family with Sam, but her plans didn't turn out like she hoped. Now, with her marriage in tatters, she's trying to decide how to get her life back on track and make up for lost time.
espanol: Quando era mais nova, a Lily largou uma carreira promissora pra construir uma família perfeita com o Sam, mas os planos dela não deram certo como ela esperava. Agora, com o casamento acabado, ela tá tentando decidir como colocar a vida de volta nos eixos e compensar o tempo perdido.

ingles: Tough on the outside, sweet on the inside
espanol: Duro por fora, doce por dentro

ingles: Sue is a tough, bossy, independent young woman with parents out of the picture and a whole lot of attitude. However, her blunt, standoffish demeanor actually hides a sensitive, empathetic woman who dearly misses her deceased uncle, whom she loved very much.
espanol: Sue é uma jovem durona, mandona e independente, sem os pais por perto e com um temperamento forte. Mas, por trás dessa aparência rude e distante, esconde-se uma mulher sensível e empática, que sente muita falta do tio falecido, a quem amava muito.

ingles: Susan's niece, Sue, is a rebellious girl who doesn't get along with her parents. She acts stoic and cold, with some of her words coming off as cruel, but all she wants is someone to truly listen to her.
espanol: A sobrinha da Susan, Sue, é uma garota rebelde que não se dá bem com os pais. Ela age de forma fria e indiferente, e algumas das coisas que diz parecem cruéis, mas tudo o que ela quer é alguém que a ouça de verdade.
Garota esperta e que entende de tecnologia

ingles: Chloe is an intelligent and charismatic girl who loves reading and watching science fiction shows like Doctor Who. She loves solving mysteries and can't contain her curiosity when it comes to discovering secrets and scandals surrounding friends and famous people around the city — especially if solving said mystery helps a friend.
espanol: Chloe é uma garota inteligente e carismática que adora ler e assistir programas de ficção científica, como Doctor Who. Ela adora resolver mistérios e não consegue conter a curiosidade quando se trata de descobrir segredos e escândalos envolvendo amigos e pessoas famosas da cidade — especialmente se resolver o mistério ajudar um amigo.

ingles: She is outgoing and can be quite insistent when she dubs a subject compelling, but she also has a voyeuristic side that she keeps secret, liking to watch people in their most intimate moments.
espanol: Ela é extrovertida e pode ser bem insistente quando acha um assunto interessante, mas também tem um lado voyeurista que mantém em segredo, curtindo observar as pessoas nos seus momentos mais íntimos.
Uma mulher de negócios misteriosa e discreta

ingles: Susan is a college friend of the main character's mother, promising to help the boy when he signed up for school in the big city. She offered him a job and even found him a place to live. But after a closer look, she seems to know a lot about the main character's past, and her evasive manner suggests she's hiding something.
espanol: Susan é amiga da mãe do protagonista da faculdade e prometeu ajudar o garoto quando ele se matriculou na escola na cidade grande. Ela ofereceu um emprego e até achou um lugar pra ele morar. Mas, olhando melhor, parece que ela sabe muito sobre o passado do protagonista, e o jeito evasivo dela dá a entender que ela tá escondendo alguma coisa.

ingles: Susan is a widow without any children, but she has a niece named Sue who also works for her. Susan seems harsh and overbearing, but underneath all that bravado, she's a caring and loving soul who fears she'll never find love again.
espanol: Susan é viúva e não tem filhos, mas tem uma sobrinha chamada Sue que também trabalha para ela. Susan parece dura e autoritária, mas por baixo de toda essa bravata, ela é uma pessoa carinhosa e amorosa que tem medo de nunca mais encontrar o amor.

ingles: Julia is the kind of girl who lights up the room just by being herself — cheerful, sweet, and always ready to jump into something new (especially if that means helping a friend). Whether it be a last-minute road trip or a weekend gaming marathon, she's all in.
espanol: Julia é o tipo de garota que ilumina o ambiente só de estar presente — alegre, doce e sempre pronta para se aventurar em algo novo (principalmente se isso significar ajudar uma amiga). Seja uma viagem de última hora ou uma maratona de jogos no fim de semana, ela está sempre dentro.

ingles: Playful by nature and curious at heart, she has a soft spot for the unexpected, which includes her more intimate adventures. She never knows exactly where things will lead, and that thrill is half the fun.
espanol: De natureza divertida e curiosa, ela tem um fraquinho por coisas inesperadas, incluindo suas aventuras mais íntimas. Ela nunca sabe exatamente onde as coisas vão dar, e essa emoção é metade da diversão.

ingles: Always cheerful and good-humored, Alyssa is a determined girl with big dreams. During the day, she works as a waitress in a cafe, and at night, she teaches dance. Her dream is to have her own dance studio and form a group to take the stage with her.
espanol: Sempre alegre e de bom humor, Alyssa é uma garota determinada com grandes sonhos. Durante o dia, ela trabalha como garçonete em um café e, à noite, dá aulas de dança. O sonho dela é ter seu próprio estúdio de dança e formar um grupo para se apresentar no palco com ela.

ingles: Alyssa works two jobs to help her mother pay the bills and feed two younger brothers. Don't be fooled by her difficulties though; Alyssa is not a girl who sits around complaining. She's always one to find a solution, shooting down each of her problems one by one.
espanol: A Alyssa tem dois empregos pra ajudar a mãe a pagar as contas e cuidar dos dois irmãos mais novos. Mas não se deixe enganar pelas dificuldades dela; a Alyssa não é uma garota que fica sentada reclamando. Ela sempre encontra uma solução, resolvendo cada um dos seus problemas um por um.

ingles: Emily is a mystery wrapped in an enigma. She seems like an airhead, but then she seems to know more than she's letting on. She gives a sort of dopey and oblivious impression, speaking in a soft tone, but there's something off about her that the main character simply can't explain.
espanol: Emily é um mistério dentro de outro mistério. Ela parece meio distraída, mas parece saber mais do que deixa transparecer. Ela passa uma impressão meio boba e desligada, fala num tom suave, mas tem algo nela que o personagem principal simplesmente não consegue explicar.

ingles: Something in the back of the main character's mind whispers that Emily might have something to do with his past, but he can't be sure why. He can't remember anything about her being a part of his life from before.
espanol: Algo no fundo da mente do protagonista sussurra que Emily pode ter algo a ver com seu passado, mas ele não tem certeza do porquê. Ele não consegue se lembrar de nada sobre ela fazer parte de sua vida antes.

ingles: Devilla and her friend Angela came from Russia, and they're both working as strippers at the bar they own, known as Hell Angels. Devilla is the “bad cop” of the duo, being rather hot-headed and easy to anger. She likes to help, but she's known to ask for something in return. For some reason, she does seem to have a soft spot for our protagonist.
espanol: Devilla e sua amiga Angela vieram da Rússia e ambas trabalham como strippers no bar que elas têm, chamado Hell Angels. Devilla é a “policial má” da dupla, sendo bastante impulsiva e fácil de irritar. Ela gosta de ajudar, mas é conhecida por pedir algo em troca. Por alguma razão, ela parece ter uma queda pelo nosso protagonista.

ingles: Devilla is quite manipulative and knows how to win people over, and she's ready to use all of her skills to transform Hell Angels into the best nightclub in town. Whoever's by her side when that happens better be on good terms with her.
espanol: Devilla é bem manipuladora e sabe como conquistar as pessoas, e ela está pronta para usar todas as suas habilidades para transformar o Hell Angels na melhor boate da cidade. Quem estiver ao lado dela quando isso acontecer, é melhor estar em bons termos com ela.

ingles: Just a good girl from Russia
espanol: Apenas uma boa garota da Rússia

ingles: Angela and her friend Devilla came from Russia, and they're both working as strippers at the bar they own, known as Hell Angels. Angela is the “good cop” of the duo, being more sweet and caring — sometimes even seeming a bit naive. However, that's just her way of nudging things toward her desired result.
espanol: Angela e sua amiga Devilla vieram da Rússia e ambas trabalham como strippers no bar que elas têm, chamado Hell Angels. Angela é a “policial boa” da dupla, sendo mais doce e carinhosa — às vezes até parecendo um pouco ingênua. Mas isso é só o jeito dela de conseguir o que quer.

ingles: Angela is a skilled entrepreneur, and despite her skills as a stripper, she studies at Minerva Bay College and dreams of turning Hell Angels into the best nightclub in town.
espanol: Angela é uma empreendedora talentosa e, mesmo sendo uma stripper, estuda na Minerva Bay College e sonha em transformar o Hell Angels na melhor boate da cidade.

ingles: Is my class as interesting as my tits?
espanol: Minha aula é tão interessante quanto meus peitos?

ingles: Professor Watson is a new hire at Minerva Bay College, teaching economics to the likes of Dylan and the main character. She's known to be mean and likes to tease her students, especially Dylan since he failed her class once before. Still, she has a passion for her subject and her well-endowed bosom.
espanol: A professora Watson é nova na Minerva Bay College, onde dá aulas de economia para o Dylan e o personagem principal. Ela é conhecida por ser malvada e gosta de provocar os alunos, principalmente o Dylan, que já foi reprovado na disciplina dela. Mesmo assim, ela é apaixonada pelo que ensina e pelo seu peito avantajado.

ingles: Professor Watson is the stereotype of a hot teacher, and she knows it. With her arrogance and self-confidence, she both seduces and intimidates her students, known to make inappropriate and embarrassing comments. Will the main character be able to resist the pressure she brings?
espanol: A professora Watson é o estereótipo da professora gostosa, e ela sabe disso. Com sua arrogância e autoconfiança, ela seduz e intimida seus alunos, conhecida por fazer comentários inapropriados e embaraçosos. Será que o personagem principal vai conseguir resistir à pressão que ela exerce?

ingles: Gabby is the newest lead at Angela and Devilla's bar. She's sweet, kind, and a great listener. She attends the same university as the main character and is terrified that her teachers and the faculty might learn about her side hustle.
espanol: A Gabby é a nova chefe no bar da Angela e da Devilla. Ela é fofa, legal e sabe ouvir muito bem. Ela estuda na mesma faculdade que a protagonista e tem muito medo que seus professores e colegas descubram o que ela faz pra ganhar uma grana extra.

ingles: Gabby's dream is to become a famous scientist, but she is willing to do whatever it takes to pay her bills and graduate college —that is, as long as she can be discreet about it and make sure it doesn't ruin her reputation.
espanol: O sonho da Gabby é virar uma cientista famosa, mas ela tá disposta a fazer o que for preciso pra pagar as contas e terminar a faculdade — isso sim, desde que ela consiga manter a discrição e não estragar sua reputação.

ingles: You scratch my back, and I'll scratch yours
espanol: Você me ajuda e eu te ajudo

ingles: Carolyne is a nurse who's been known to take jobs for Fred. She doesn't ask questions and doesn't want to answer any either. She's mysterious and keeps both her past and the circumstances she met Fred under a secret.
espanol: Carolyne é uma enfermeira conhecida por aceitar trabalhos para Fred. Ela não faz perguntas e também não quer responder a nenhuma. Ela é misteriosa e mantém em segredo tanto o seu passado quanto as circunstâncias em que conheceu Fred.

ingles: Carolyne seems to be a trustworthy person, willing to help the main character with his daddy issues. She's charming and confident, seeming to honestly care about the main character's well-being.
espanol: A Carolyne parece ser uma pessoa de confiança, disposta a ajudar o protagonista com seus problemas com o pai. Ela é charmosa e confiante, parecendo se importar de verdade com o bem-estar do protagonista.

ingles: Mae is a regular customer of Susan's. She is a masseuse with a particular interest in the main character after he's tasked with delivering a package to her. Mae is soft-spoken and very eager to get her hands on whatever man comes her way.
espanol: Mae é uma cliente regular da Susan. Ela é massagista e tem um interesse especial pelo protagonista depois que ele é encarregado de entregar um pacote para ela. Mae é de fala mansa e muito ansiosa para colocar as mãos em qualquer homem que cruze seu caminho.

ingles: Mae cares a lot about her looks, so she doesn't look her age even though she's in her forties. She seems to be an influential person in Minerva Bay, and although she's discreet, she seems to take a liking to the younger boys...
espanol: A Mae liga muito pra aparência, então ela não parece ter a idade que tem, mesmo já estando na casa dos quarenta. Ela parece ser uma pessoa influente em Minerva Bay e, apesar de ser discreta, parece gostar dos garotos mais novos...

ingles: If life gives you lemons... use them to shoot vodka!
espanol: Se a vida te der limões... use-os para beber vodca!

ingles: Dylan is the main character's best friend. He's carefree and always joking — with a flair for the dramatic. Although he talks normally around the main character, Dylan pretends to be Russian around the ladies.
espanol: Dylan é o melhor amigo do personagem principal. Ele é despreocupado e está sempre brincando — com um talento especial para o drama. Embora fale normalmente com o personagem principal, Dylan finge ser russo quando está perto das mulheres.

ingles: Even though he's somehow managed to hide this big secret from others, Dylan is a great friend that the main character can count on for even the craziest of adventures. He would literally drive across the country to get a friend out of trouble.
espanol: Mesmo tendo conseguido esconder esse grande segredo dos outros, o Dylan é um grande amigo com quem o protagonista pode contar até nas aventuras mais malucas. Ele literalmente atravessaria o país de carro para tirar um amigo de apuros.

ingles: I'd do anything for my family
espanol: Eu faria qualquer coisa pela minha família.

ingles: The main character's mother is a loving person, but she can be rather overprotective and seems to know more than she lets on. She can be a bit overbearing, but it's always with the best of intentions.
espanol: A mãe da personagem principal é uma pessoa carinhosa, mas pode ser um pouco superprotetora e parece saber mais do que deixa transparecer. Ela pode ser um pouco autoritária, mas sempre com a melhor das intenções.

ingles: Debra loves Fred unconditionally, leaving questions about how complicit she was in Fred's business. Perhaps she really was completely oblivious to everything that happened in the past.
espanol: A Debra ama o Fred de verdade, o que deixa a gente pensando se ela sabia das coisas que o Fred fazia. Talvez ela realmente não tivesse ideia do que rolava no passado.

ingles: I have to prove my innocence
espanol: Eu tenho que provar que sou inocente.

ingles: Fred is the main character's father. He's been missing for fifteen years after a bad deal went south, leading to his being arrested. He wants to be reunited with his family more than anything else and is willing to do whatever it takes to do so.
espanol: Fred é o pai do personagem principal. Ele está desaparecido há quinze anos, depois que um negócio ruim deu errado e ele foi preso. Ele quer muito se reunir com a família e está disposto a fazer o que for preciso para isso.

ingles: On top of that, Fred seeks revenge against the person he believes to be truly responsible for his fate and will do everything to ensure that the truth about his past is revealed and that the guilty parties are punished.
espanol: Além disso, Fred quer se vingar da pessoa que ele acha que é a verdadeira responsável pelo seu destino e vai fazer de tudo pra que a verdade sobre o seu passado seja revelada e os culpados sejam punidos.

ingles: Sam is Lily's husband and the co-owner of a large investment firm. He's possessive and gets angry easily. When he's at his best though, he is an extremely charming man. He did a lot of business with Fred in the past and is one of the prime suspects behind his disappearance.
espanol: Sam é o marido da Lily e dono de uma grande empresa de investimentos. Ele é meio possessivo e fica bravo fácil. Mas, quando tá de boa, é um cara super charmoso. Ele fez muitos negócios com o Fred no passado e é um dos principais suspeitos por trás do desaparecimento dele.

ingles: After all his investigating, the main character is convinced that Sam is the real villain behind his father's disappearance. But will the main character be able to prove his suspicions?
espanol: Depois de toda a sua investigação, o protagonista está convencido de que Sam é o verdadeiro vilão por trás do desaparecimento de seu pai. Mas será que o protagonista vai conseguir provar suas suspeitas?
Vou fazer o que é certo!

ingles: Charlie was Susan's husband and a partner of both Fred and Sam. He always stood for what was right in the business, so when things took a turn for the worse, he was quick to turn on his partners. This, in turn, made Fred and Sam resent him.
espanol: Charlie era o marido de Susan e sócio de Fred e Sam. Ele sempre defendeu o que era certo nos negócios, então, quando as coisas começaram a piorar, ele não hesitou em se voltar contra seus sócios. Isso, por sua vez, fez com que Fred e Sam ficassem com raiva dele.

ingles: Charlie passed away in a traffic accident a few years ago.
espanol: O Charlie morreu num acidente de trânsito há alguns anos.

ingles: Life is a mole on a chick's ass... You just got to have fun with it!
espanol: A vida é uma verruga na bunda de uma galinha... Você só precisa se divertir com ela!

ingles: Bruce is a senior at Minerva Bay College and the head of the Sigma-Pi-Nu fraternity. Along with his girlfriend Heather, he organizes parties and other events to welcome the freshmen to campus, enjoying when he can cause mayhem and mischief at the university. The more epic, the better!
espanol: Bruce tá no último ano da Minerva Bay College e é o chefe da fraternidade Sigma-Pi-Nu. Junto com a namorada Heather, ele organiza festas e outros eventos pra dar as boas-vindas aos calouros no campus, curtindo quando consegue causar confusão e travessuras na universidade. Quanto mais épico, melhor!

ingles: Well... let's see what you're capable of.
espanol: Bom... vamos ver do que você é capaz.

ingles: Heather is a senior at Minerva Bay College, and she doesn't seem to like the main character very much. She's Bruce's girlfriend, and she enjoys picking on the freshmen during fraternity events. The main character wants to do everything he can to convince her that he is, in fact, a nice guy who deserves her respect. But will he succeed?
espanol: Heather tá no último ano da Minerva Bay College e não parece curtir muito o protagonista. Ela é namorada do Bruce e adora zoar os calouros nos eventos da fraternidade. O protagonista quer fazer de tudo pra convencê-la de que ele é, na verdade, um cara legal que merece o respeito dela. Será que ele vai conseguir?

ingles: Donna is the vice dean at Minerva Bay College and is currently extremely unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. With her aggressive and uncompromising stance, she vows to combat lewd behavior from her students, known to fight fiercely for morals and righteous behavior.
espanol: Donna é vice-reitora da Minerva Bay College e tá super insatisfeita com a direção errada que a universidade tá tomando. Com sua postura agressiva e intransigente, ela promete combater o comportamento indecente dos alunos, conhecida por lutar ferozmente pela moral e pelo comportamento correto.

ingles: When Donna discovers that some university students work and live at a local bar that is home to a number of unbecoming activities, she begins a campaign against the owners.
espanol: Quando Donna descobre que alguns estudantes universitários trabalham e moram em um bar local que é palco de várias atividades impróprias, ela começa uma campanha contra os donos.

ingles: Maybe we can solve this with a simple conversation
espanol: Talvez a gente consiga resolver isso com uma conversa simples.

ingles: Jack is the dean of the university, but his position seems to be under threat from Donna, unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. Jack doesn't seem to be making any effort to maintain morality and righteous behavior within the university. In fact, he might even be taking a few liberties with his power. However, this has left some members of the board less than pleased. Could his position be under threat?
espanol: Jack é o reitor da universidade, mas parece que o cargo dele tá ameaçado pela Donna, que tá insatisfeita com a direção errada que a universidade tá tomando. Jack não parece estar fazendo nenhum esforço pra manter a moralidade e o comportamento correto dentro da universidade. Na verdade, ele pode até estar abusando um pouco do seu poder. No entanto, isso deixou alguns membros do conselho bem insatisfeitos. Será que o cargo dele tá ameaçado?

ingles: This isn't in the rules... but I'll see what I can do.
espanol: Isso não tá nas regras... mas vou ver o que posso fazer.

ingles: Janine works at Minerva Bay College as a secretary. She has a soft spot for Dylan but is otherwise a very conservative person who values 'decency' above all else.
espanol: Janine trabalha na Minerva Bay College como secretária. Ela tem uma queda pelo Dylan, mas fora isso é uma pessoa bem conservadora que valoriza a “decência” acima de tudo.

ingles: What luck! It must be because the planets are aligned!
espanol: Que sorte! Deve ser porque os planetas estão alinhados!

ingles: Jessa is athletic, full of attitude, and has a biting sense of humor. She's a freshman at Minerva Bay College is looking for alternative ways to earn more money to support herself.
espanol: Jessa é atlética, cheia de atitude e tem um humor sarcástico. Ela é caloura na Minerva Bay College e está procurando maneiras alternativas de ganhar mais dinheiro para se sustentar.

ingles: Jessa heard there was a local bar recruiting girls to work there and saw it as a good opportunity to get some extra income. She sees the looks men are always giving her, and she doesn't mind using that to her advantage.
espanol: Jessa ouviu falar que um bar local estava recrutando garotas para trabalhar lá e viu isso como uma boa chance de ganhar um dinheiro extra. Ela percebe os olhares que os homens sempre lançam para ela e não se importa em usar isso a seu favor.

ingles: This is awkward... but maybe we can work with it.
espanol: Isso é meio estranho... mas talvez a gente consiga resolver.

ingles: Chery is a shy girl who devotes herself to her studies. Being so intelligent and in her own head all the time, she has a bit of difficulty with social situations... That is, until she received a mysterious proposal about a local bar recruiting girls to work there.
espanol: Chery é uma garota tímida que se dedica aos estudos. Por ser tão inteligente e estar sempre no mundo dela, ela tem um pouco de dificuldade com situações sociais... Isso até receber uma proposta misteriosa de um bar local que estava recrutando garotas para trabalhar lá.

ingles: Although Chery was initially uncomfortable with the idea, she eventually reconsidered and accepted the invitation to join Hell Angels. After all, she really needed the extra money...
espanol: Embora Chery inicialmente não se sentisse à vontade com a ideia, ela acabou reconsiderando e aceitou o convite para entrar para os Hell Angels. Afinal, ela precisava mesmo do dinheiro extra...

ingles: Oh, I remember you... You're the guy who never showed up!
espanol: Ah, eu me lembro de você... Você é o cara que nunca apareceu!

ingles: Madison is Chloe's friend, another member of the book club. the main character doesn't know much about her, but she definitely caught his eye... A fact that she didn't seem to object to.
espanol: Madison é amiga de Chloe, outra integrante do clube do livro. O protagonista não sabe muito sobre ela, mas ela definitivamente chamou sua atenção... Um fato que ela não pareceu se importar.

ingles: Soft spoken and a good listener
espanol: De fala mansa e bom ouvinte

ingles: Maybe we can help each other out.
espanol: Talvez a gente possa dar uma força um pro outro.

ingles: Laura is the police officer who approaches the main character after she opens up an old case linked to the events surrounding Fred and his disappearance. She became a police officer after seeing her father being wronged and forced to pay for a crime he didn't commit.
espanol: Laura é a policial que aborda a personagem principal depois que ela reabre um caso antigo ligado aos acontecimentos em torno de Fred e seu desaparecimento. Ela se tornou policial depois de ver seu pai ser injustiçado e forçado a pagar por um crime que não cometeu.

ingles: Since then, Laura has decided to help people who find themselves in similar situations to hers to prevent others from being wrongfully convicted. She seems quite helpful and persuasive, two qualities that could help her become a strong ally in the main character's search for the truth.
espanol: Desde então, Laura decidiu ajudar pessoas que estão na mesma situação que ela, pra evitar que outras pessoas sejam condenadas injustamente. Ela parece bem prestativa e persuasiva, duas qualidades que podem ajudá-la a se tornar uma grande aliada na busca da verdade do personagem principal.

ingles: Tyler is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. He and Claire are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, he shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether he's friend or foe there.
espanol: Tyler é um calouro na Minerva Bay College e também frequenta a escola de dança da Alyssa. Ele e Claire são amigos de infância e estão sempre juntos. Durante a competição da fraternidade, ele aparece entre os competidores, mas ainda não dá pra saber se ele é amigo ou inimigo.

ingles: Claire is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. She and Tyler are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, she shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether she's friend or foe to the girls there.
espanol: Claire é uma caloura na Minerva Bay College e também frequenta a escola de dança da Alyssa. Ela e o Tyler são amigos de infância e estão sempre juntos. Durante a competição da fraternidade, ela aparece entre os competidores, mas ainda não dá pra saber se ela é amiga ou inimiga das garotas de lá.

ingles: Greg is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competitions. He is tall, strong, and bald. Though that certainly gives him a menacing appearance, the reality is far from it. On the contrary, he's goofy, simple-minded, and borderline cute at times. He dresses like a metalhead and likes to draw. You can see the soul of an artist lurking within.
espanol: Greg é um calouro da Minerva Bay College que tá participando das competições da fraternidade. Ele é alto, forte e careca. Embora isso certamente lhe dê uma aparência ameaçadora, a realidade é bem diferente. Pelo contrário, ele é engraçado, simples e, às vezes, quase fofo. Ele se veste como um metaleiro e gosta de desenhar. Dá pra ver a alma de um artista escondida dentro dele.

ingles: May the force be with me

Ned is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and although he doesn't seem very threatening, he can be a handful. He's also a huge Science Fiction fan and sometimes dresses up as a Jedi...
espanol: Ned é um calouro da Minerva Bay College que tá participando da competição de fraternidades. Ele tá no time que tá competindo contra o personagem principal e, embora não pareça muito ameaçador, ele pode ser um pouco difícil de lidar. Ele também é um grande fã de ficção científica e às vezes se veste de Jedi...

ingles: You'll never gonna beat me, Sigma Boy!
espanol: Você nunca vai me derrotar, Sigma Boy!

ingles: Josh is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and every hint leads the main character to believe he'll be trouble. In addition to being a strong competitor, he's singled out the main character as his main rival and wants to make that crystal clear.
espanol: Josh é um calouro da Minerva Bay College que tá participando da competição de fraternidades. Ele tá no time que tá competindo contra o personagem principal, e todas as dicas fazem o personagem principal achar que ele vai ser um problema. Além de ser um competidor forte, ele escolheu o personagem principal como seu principal rival e quer deixar isso bem claro.

ingles: Kaylee is Josh's partner during the sorority competitions. We don't know much about her, but she's definitely a freshman at Minerva Bay College... or she wouldn't be competing.
espanol: Kaylee é a parceira de Josh nas competições da irmandade. Não sabemos muito sobre ela, mas com certeza é caloura na Minerva Bay College... senão não estaria competindo.

ingles: He's the bouncer at Hell Angels, a local bar. We don't know much about him... After all, he's not much of a talker.
espanol: Ele é segurança no Hell Angels, um bar local. Não sabemos muito sobre ele... Afinal, ele não é muito de falar.
O que você faz na vida?

ingles: As a thank you to everyone who continues to believe in our project and chose to support the game by purchasing the Supporter Pack, we've prepared a special gift: an exclusive 3D-printable file for a figurine of Julia.
espanol: Como um agradecimento a todos que continuam acreditando no nosso projeto e decidiram apoiar o jogo comprando o Pacote de Apoiante, a gente preparou um presente especial: um arquivo exclusivo para impressão em 3D de uma estatueta da Julia.

ingles: This gift is more than just a digital item — it's a symbol of appreciation for those who helped make the game possible. We designed this statue for the fans who truly care about the world we're building and want to bring a piece of it into their own homes.
espanol: Esse presente é mais do que só um item digital — é um símbolo de gratidão pra quem ajudou a tornar o jogo possível. A gente criou essa estátua pros fãs que realmente se importam com o mundo que estamos construindo e querem levar um pedacinho dele pra casa.

ingles: We know that supporting a game is an act of trust and passion, and this small tribute is our way of giving something meaningful back — something personal, unique, and made to be proudly displayed.
espanol: A gente sabe que apoiar um jogo é um ato de confiança e paixão, e essa pequena homenagem é a nossa maneira de retribuir com algo significativo — algo pessoal, único e feito para ser exibido com orgulho.
