ingles: Don't forget to save your progress
This game supports a self-voicing mode in which a speech synthesizer is used to read out text and other interface elements, this is intended to make accessible to the vision impaired.
espanol: El juego cuenta con una herramienta de accesibilidad para las personas con discapacidad visual en el que se usa un sintetizador de voz para leer el texto y otros elementos de la interfaz.

ingles: Our main character is a curious and inquisitive young man trying to find his way into adulthood as a freshman at Minerva Bay College. As he meets new friends and flirts with all sorts of girls, he does his best to deal with the ghosts of his past.
espanol: Nuestro protagonista es un joven curioso y con ganas de descubrir la verdad mientras intenta hacerse a la vida adulta en el Minerva Bay College. Hace lo que puede para lidiar con los fantasmas de su pasado mientras entabla nuevas amistades y liga con las chicas.

ingles: Our main character had an accident and lost a good chunk of his recent memories. As he tries to remember his past, he searches for any signs of his father's whereabouts or clues that the people around him were involved in his sudden disappearance.
espanol: Sufrió un accidente y perdió gran parte de sus recuerdos recientes. A la vez que intenta recordar su pasado, también busca cualquier indicio del paradero de su padre o pistas que apunten a que las personas de su entorno están involucradas en su repentina desaparición.

ingles: Lily is married to a man she clearly doesn't love anymore, and she resents herself for it. She sees her own lost youth in our protagonist and starts feeling tempted to relive those glory days and make some different choices.
espanol: Lily está casada con un hombre al que ya no ama, y se odia por ello. Cuando ve al protagonista, también ve la juventud que ha desperdiciado y comienza a sentir la urgencia de tomar decisiones drásticas y comenzar a vivir su vida.

ingles: As a young woman, Lily gave up her promising career to build a perfect family with Sam, but her plans didn't turn out like she hoped. Now, with her marriage in tatters, she's trying to decide how to get her life back on track and make up for lost time.
espanol: Decidió abandonar su prometedora carrera de joven para casarse y tener la familia perfecta con Sam, pero las cosas no han salido como ella esperaba. Ahora, con el matrimonio en las últimas, quiere descubrir cómo recuperar y vivir los años de juventud perdidos.

ingles: Tough on the outside, sweet on the inside
espanol: Fría por fuera, afectuosa por dentro

ingles: Sue is a tough, bossy, independent young woman with parents out of the picture and a whole lot of attitude. However, her blunt, standoffish demeanor actually hides a sensitive, empathetic woman who dearly misses her deceased uncle, whom she loved very much.
espanol: Sue es una mujer joven, fuerte, independiente, mandona y con un carácter de armas tomar. Aunque su apariencia distante y directa esconde una mujer sensible y empática que echa muchísimo de menos a su tío fallecido, al que quería con locura.

ingles: Susan's niece, Sue, is a rebellious girl who doesn't get along with her parents. She acts stoic and cold, with some of her words coming off as cruel, but all she wants is someone to truly listen to her.
espanol: Es una rebelde y no se lleva bien con sus padres. Por fuera es fría como un témpano con una forma de decir las cosas muy hiriente, pero lo que más desea es que alguien la escuche de verdad.

ingles: Chloe is an intelligent and charismatic girl who loves reading and watching science fiction shows like Doctor Who. She loves solving mysteries and can't contain her curiosity when it comes to discovering secrets and scandals surrounding friends and famous people around the city — especially if solving said mystery helps a friend.
espanol: Chloe es una chica inteligente y carismática a la que le encanta leer y ver series de ciencia ficción, como Doctor Who. Le pirran resolver misterios y descubrir los secretos y escándalos que ocultan sus amigos y la gente famosa de la ciudad. Puede que tenga demasiada curiosidad por las cosas, pero si eso ayuda a un amigo, mejor que mejor, ¿no?

ingles: She is outgoing and can be quite insistent when she dubs a subject compelling, but she also has a voyeuristic side that she keeps secret, liking to watch people in their most intimate moments.
espanol: Es extrovertida y a veces peca de monotemática si un tema la interesa mucho, pero esconde una faceta voyeurista: le gusta observar a la gente en sus momentos más íntimos.

ingles: Susan is a college friend of the main character's mother, promising to help the boy when he signed up for school in the big city. She offered him a job and even found him a place to live. But after a closer look, she seems to know a lot about the main character's past, and her evasive manner suggests she's hiding something.
espanol: Susan es amiga de la universidad de la madre del protagonista y ha prometido ayudarlo tras haberse matriculado en la gran ciudad. Le ha ofrecido un trabajo y un techo, pero, tras esa fachada amable, se esconde una mujer que sabe mucho de su pasado y, por cómo evade ciertas cuestiones, parece que oculta algo...

ingles: Susan is a widow without any children, but she has a niece named Sue who also works for her. Susan seems harsh and overbearing, but underneath all that bravado, she's a caring and loving soul who fears she'll never find love again.
espanol: Es una viuda sin hijos, pero por lo menos tiene a Sue, su sobrina, que además trabaja para ella. Susan es fría y controladora, pero bajo esa fachada es una persona cariñosa que teme no volver a encontrar el amor.
Ir a por problemas y encontrar diversión

ingles: Julia is the kind of girl who lights up the room just by being herself — cheerful, sweet, and always ready to jump into something new (especially if that means helping a friend). Whether it be a last-minute road trip or a weekend gaming marathon, she's all in.
espanol: Julia es la típica chica que ilumina una habitación con su presencia: es divertida, amable y no tiene miedo de probar cosas nuevas, sobre todo si es por ayudar a una amiga. ¿Un viaje por carretera improvisado o un fin de semana de videojuegos? ¡Se apunta sin pensarlo!

ingles: Playful by nature and curious at heart, she has a soft spot for the unexpected, which includes her more intimate adventures. She never knows exactly where things will lead, and that thrill is half the fun.
espanol: Es traviesa y curiosa, y su punto débil es lo inesperado, hasta en sus aventuras más íntimas. Nunca sabe hacia dónde irán las cosas, y eso es parte de la diversión.

ingles: Always cheerful and good-humored, Alyssa is a determined girl with big dreams. During the day, she works as a waitress in a cafe, and at night, she teaches dance. Her dream is to have her own dance studio and form a group to take the stage with her.
espanol: Alyssa es una chica atrevida que sueña a lo grande, tiene un buen sentido del humor y es feliz. Por el día, trabaja de camarera en una cafetería y de noche da clases de baile. Su sueño es conseguir su propio estudio y formar un grupo con el que subirse al escenario.

ingles: Alyssa works two jobs to help her mother pay the bills and feed two younger brothers. Don't be fooled by her difficulties though; Alyssa is not a girl who sits around complaining. She's always one to find a solution, shooting down each of her problems one by one.
espanol: Tiene dos trabajos para ayudar a su madre con las facturas y a alimentar a sus dos hermanos pequeños, pero jamás la oirás quejarse. Siempre ve el lado positivo e intenta buscar la solución a sus problemas uno a uno.

ingles: Emily is a mystery wrapped in an enigma. She seems like an airhead, but then she seems to know more than she's letting on. She gives a sort of dopey and oblivious impression, speaking in a soft tone, but there's something off about her that the main character simply can't explain.
espanol: Emily es una caja de sorpresas. Todo el mundo piensa que es una cabeza de chorlito, pero nadie se ha parado a pensar que se esté haciendo la tonta. La primera impresión que te llevas es de alguien que no sabe por dónde le da el viento, pero al protagonista le da mala espina, aunque no sabe muy bien por qué.

ingles: Something in the back of the main character's mind whispers that Emily might have something to do with his past, but he can't be sure why. He can't remember anything about her being a part of his life from before.
espanol: El protagonista no se puede quitar la sensación de que Emily tiene algo que ver con su pasado, pero es solo una sensación. No la recuerda.
Una chica muy muy mala de Rusia

ingles: Devilla and her friend Angela came from Russia, and they're both working as strippers at the bar they own, known as Hell Angels. Devilla is the “bad cop” of the duo, being rather hot-headed and easy to anger. She likes to help, but she's known to ask for something in return. For some reason, she does seem to have a soft spot for our protagonist.
espanol: Devilla y Angela, su amiga, llegaron desde Rusia, y ambas trabajan como estríperes en Hell Angels, su bar. Devilla es la «poli mala» de las dos, y se la conoce por tener la mecha corta. Le encanta ayudar, pero no a cambio de nada y, por la razón que sea, el protagonista no le cae muy bien.

ingles: Devilla is quite manipulative and knows how to win people over, and she's ready to use all of her skills to transform Hell Angels into the best nightclub in town. Whoever's by her side when that happens better be on good terms with her.
espanol: Es muy manipuladora, sabe cómo ganarse a la gente y piensa usar todos sus encantos para transformar el Hell Angels en el mejor club nocturno de la ciudad. Más le vale a la gente de su alrededor no enfadarla...

ingles: Just a good girl from Russia

Angela and her friend Devilla came from Russia, and they're both working as strippers at the bar they own, known as Hell Angels. Angela is the “good cop” of the duo, being more sweet and caring — sometimes even seeming a bit naive. However, that's just her way of nudging things toward her desired result.
espanol: Angela y Devilla, su amiga, llegaron desde Rusia y ambas trabajan como estríperes en Hell Angels, su bar. Angela es la «poli buena» de las dos; es amable y empática, y la gente la suele tomar por ingenua, pero no es más que una fachada para llevar las cosas a su terreno y conseguir lo que quiere.

ingles: Angela is a skilled entrepreneur, and despite her skills as a stripper, she studies at Minerva Bay College and dreams of turning Hell Angels into the best nightclub in town.
espanol: Es una empresaria con mucho éxito. Tiene un talento natural para el estriptis, y también estudia en el Minerva Bay College con el sueño de convertir Hell Angels en el mejor club nocturno de la ciudad.

ingles: Is my class as interesting as my tits?
espanol: Espero que mi clase sea tan interesante como mis tetas

ingles: Professor Watson is a new hire at Minerva Bay College, teaching economics to the likes of Dylan and the main character. She's known to be mean and likes to tease her students, especially Dylan since he failed her class once before. Still, she has a passion for her subject and her well-endowed bosom.
espanol: La profesora Watson es nueva en Minerva Bay College y enseña Economía. Es algo mezquina y le gusta burlarse de sus estudiantes, sobre todo de Dylan tras suspender su asignatura. Le gusta enseñar dos cosas: su asignatura y sus pechos.

ingles: Professor Watson is the stereotype of a hot teacher, and she knows it. With her arrogance and self-confidence, she both seduces and intimidates her students, known to make inappropriate and embarrassing comments. Will the main character be able to resist the pressure she brings?
espanol: Es la típica profesora que te viene a la mente cuando piensas en la «profesora buenorra», y lo sabe. Su exceso de confianza y arrogancia le vale para seducir e intimidar a los estudiantes mientras hace comentarios inapropiados y vergonzosos. ¿Será capaz el protagonista de aguantar la presión que ejerce sobre él?
Una persona con la que desahogarse

ingles: Gabby is the newest lead at Angela and Devilla's bar. She's sweet, kind, and a great listener. She attends the same university as the main character and is terrified that her teachers and the faculty might learn about her side hustle.
espanol: Gabby es la nueva gerente del bar de Angela y Devilla. Es buena persona, amable y sabe escuchar; aunque tiene mucho miedo de que la universidad, la misma a la que va el protagonista, y los profesores se acaben enterando de su trabajo...

ingles: Gabby's dream is to become a famous scientist, but she is willing to do whatever it takes to pay her bills and graduate college —that is, as long as she can be discreet about it and make sure it doesn't ruin her reputation.
espanol: Sueña con convertirse en una científica famosa, pero hará todo lo que esté en su mano para pagar las facturas y poder graduarse... mientras lo que haga no salga a la luz y arruine su reputación.
Encantadora y segura de sí misma

ingles: You scratch my back, and I'll scratch yours
espanol: Hoy por ti, mañana por mí

ingles: Carolyne is a nurse who's been known to take jobs for Fred. She doesn't ask questions and doesn't want to answer any either. She's mysterious and keeps both her past and the circumstances she met Fred under a secret.
espanol: Carolyne es una enfermera que le aceptaba algunos trabajos de Fred. No pregunta y tampoco responde a nada. Es misteriosa y mantiene tanto su pasado como la historia de cómo conoció a Fred secretos.

ingles: Carolyne seems to be a trustworthy person, willing to help the main character with his daddy issues. She's charming and confident, seeming to honestly care about the main character's well-being.
espanol: Parece una persona de fiar y con ganas de ayudar al protagonista con los problemas derivados de la ausencia de su padre. Es encantadora, rebosa confianza y quiere que al protagonista le vaya bien.

ingles: Mae is a regular customer of Susan's. She is a masseuse with a particular interest in the main character after he's tasked with delivering a package to her. Mae is soft-spoken and very eager to get her hands on whatever man comes her way.
espanol: Mae es una clienta habitual de Susan. Es masajista y muestra interés por el protagonista desde que él le entregó un paquete. Habla de forma muy dulce y desea echarle el guante a cualquier hombre que se le cruce.

ingles: Mae cares a lot about her looks, so she doesn't look her age even though she's in her forties. She seems to be an influential person in Minerva Bay, and although she's discreet, she seems to take a liking to the younger boys...
espanol: Le importa mucho su aspecto, por lo que no aparenta la edad que tiene, a pesar de tener ya los cuarenta. Parece ser una persona influyente en Minerva Bay y, aunque es discreta, parece que le gustan los chicos más jóvenes...

ingles: If life gives you lemons... use them to shoot vodka!
espanol: Si la vida te da limones... ¡tTómatelos con un chupito de tequila!

ingles: Dylan is the main character's best friend. He's carefree and always joking — with a flair for the dramatic. Although he talks normally around the main character, Dylan pretends to be Russian around the ladies.
espanol: Dylan es el mejor amigo del protagonista. Vive despreocupado, siempre hace bromas y tiene un don para el dramatismo. Con el protagonista habla normal, pero con las chicas se hace pasar por ruso.

ingles: Even though he's somehow managed to hide this big secret from others, Dylan is a great friend that the main character can count on for even the craziest of adventures. He would literally drive across the country to get a friend out of trouble.
espanol: Es ese gran amigo con el que se puede contar para todo, incluso para las mayores locuras del mundo. Es capaz de cruzarse el país en coche solo para ayudarte, pero tiene un gran secreto oculto...

ingles: I'd do anything for my family
espanol: Haré cualquier cosa por mi familia

ingles: The main character's mother is a loving person, but she can be rather overprotective and seems to know more than she lets on. She can be a bit overbearing, but it's always with the best of intentions.
espanol: La madre del protagonista es cariñosa, pero llega a ser sobreprotectora y sabe mucho más de lo que aparenta. Es algo controladora, pero jamás con malas intenciones.

ingles: Debra loves Fred unconditionally, leaving questions about how complicit she was in Fred's business. Perhaps she really was completely oblivious to everything that happened in the past.
espanol: Debra ama a Fred con todo su ser y las preguntas sobre cuánto sabía ella de sus negocios pululan por ahí. Puede que de verdad no supiera nada...

ingles: I have to prove my innocence

Fred is the main character's father. He's been missing for fifteen years after a bad deal went south, leading to his being arrested. He wants to be reunited with his family more than anything else and is willing to do whatever it takes to do so.
espanol: Fred es el padre del protagonista y lleva desaparecido 15 años porque un trato salió mal y acabó entre rejas. Lo que más desea en la vida es reunirse con su familia y hará lo que sea para hacerlo realidad.

ingles: On top of that, Fred seeks revenge against the person he believes to be truly responsible for his fate and will do everything to ensure that the truth about his past is revealed and that the guilty parties are punished.
espanol: Y, por si fuera poco, quiere vengarse de la persona a la que culpa de cómo le va en la vida y hará todo lo posible por sacar a la luz la verdad de su pasado y que las personas responsables paguen por ello.

ingles: Sam is Lily's husband and the co-owner of a large investment firm. He's possessive and gets angry easily. When he's at his best though, he is an extremely charming man. He did a lot of business with Fred in the past and is one of the prime suspects behind his disappearance.
espanol: Sam es el marido de Lily y el codueño de una firma financiera. Es un hombre posesivo y que se enfada con facilidad, pero cuando le van las cosas bien, es encantador a más no poder. Hizo muchos tratos con Fred en el pasado y es el principal sospechoso de su desaparición.

ingles: After all his investigating, the main character is convinced that Sam is the real villain behind his father's disappearance. But will the main character be able to prove his suspicions?
espanol: Las investigaciones han dado sus frutos y el protagonista no tiene ninguna duda: Sam está detrás de la desaparición de su padre. Pero ¿podrá demostrarlo?

ingles: Charlie was Susan's husband and a partner of both Fred and Sam. He always stood for what was right in the business, so when things took a turn for the worse, he was quick to turn on his partners. This, in turn, made Fred and Sam resent him.
espanol: Charlie era el marido de Susan y socio de Fred y Sam. Siempre defendió que los negocios se tenían que hacer con todas las de la ley, por lo que, cuando se torcieron las cosas, no dudó en delatar a sus socios... Lo que provoco que Fred y Sam lo odiaran.

ingles: Charlie passed away in a traffic accident a few years ago.
espanol: Murió hace unos años en un accidente de tráfico.

ingles: Life is a mole on a chick's ass... You just got to have fun with it!
espanol: La vida es como una peca en el trasero de una pibita... ¡Hay que divertirse con ella!

ingles: Bruce is a senior at Minerva Bay College and the head of the Sigma-Pi-Nu fraternity. Along with his girlfriend Heather, he organizes parties and other events to welcome the freshmen to campus, enjoying when he can cause mayhem and mischief at the university. The more epic, the better!
espanol: Bruce está en su último año en Minerva Bay College y es el presidente de la fraternidad Sigma Pi Nu. Organiza las fiestas y otros eventos con ayuda de su novia, Heather, para dar así la bienvenida a los de primer año. Disfruta organizando todo tipo de locuras y le encanta provocar el caos en la universidad. ¡Y cuánto más épicas, mejor!

ingles: Well... let's see what you're capable of.
espanol: Veamos de qué pasta estáis hechos

ingles: Heather is a senior at Minerva Bay College, and she doesn't seem to like the main character very much. She's Bruce's girlfriend, and she enjoys picking on the freshmen during fraternity events. The main character wants to do everything he can to convince her that he is, in fact, a nice guy who deserves her respect. But will he succeed?
espanol: Heather es estudiante de último año en el Minerva Bay College y se le nota que el protagonista no le cae muy bien. Es la novia de Bruce y le encanta meterse con los novatos en los eventos de la fraternidad. El protagonista va a darlo todo para demostrarle que es un buen tío y se merece un poco de respeto, pero ¿lo conseguirá?

ingles: Donna is the vice dean at Minerva Bay College and is currently extremely unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. With her aggressive and uncompromising stance, she vows to combat lewd behavior from her students, known to fight fiercely for morals and righteous behavior.
espanol: Donna es la vicedecana del Minerva Bay College y no le gusta nada la deriva perversa que está tomando la universidad. Tiene una personalidad intransigente y agresiva, y ha jurado combatir la conducta lasciva de sus estudiantes: la moral y la honradez prevalecerán.

ingles: When Donna discovers that some university students work and live at a local bar that is home to a number of unbecoming activities, she begins a campaign against the owners.
espanol: Cuando descubre que algunos de los estudiantes viven y trabajan en el bar de la zona donde se llevan a cabo actividades impropias, comienza una campaña contra las dueñas.

ingles: Maybe we can solve this with a simple conversation

Jack is the dean of the university, but his position seems to be under threat from Donna, unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. Jack doesn't seem to be making any effort to maintain morality and righteous behavior within the university. In fact, he might even be taking a few liberties with his power. However, this has left some members of the board less than pleased. Could his position be under threat?
espanol: Jack es el decano, pero su puesto está en jaque por culpa de Donna, quién no está nada feliz con el perverso camino que está tomando la universidad. Se ve que Jack no está haciendo nada para mantener la moralidad y un comportamiento ejemplar dentro del campus; es más, está abusando un poco de su poder y tiene a algunos de los miembros del consejo algo descontentos. ¿Acabarán echándole?

ingles: This isn't in the rules... but I'll see what I can do.
espanol: Uy, no está en las normas... Bueno, veré qué puedo hacer.

ingles: Janine works at Minerva Bay College as a secretary. She has a soft spot for Dylan but is otherwise a very conservative person who values 'decency' above all else.
espanol: Janine es la secretaria del Minerva Bay College. Tiene debilidad por Dylan, pero, quitando eso, es una persona muy conservadora que valora la decencia por encima de todo.

ingles: What luck! It must be because the planets are aligned!
espanol: ¡Mira tú qué suerte, se habrán alineado los planetas!

ingles: Jessa is athletic, full of attitude, and has a biting sense of humor. She's a freshman at Minerva Bay College is looking for alternative ways to earn more money to support herself.
espanol: Jessa es deportista, con una forma de ser de armas tomar y un humor sarcástico. Acaba de comenzar en Minerva Bay College y está buscando formas de ganar más dinero para poder salir a flote.

ingles: Jessa heard there was a local bar recruiting girls to work there and saw it as a good opportunity to get some extra income. She sees the looks men are always giving her, and she doesn't mind using that to her advantage.
espanol: Se ha enterado de que hay un bar de la zona contratando a chicas y lo ha visto como una oportunidad de oro para ganar algo más de dinero. Es muy consciente de cómo la miran los hombres, y qué mejor que usarlo a su favor.

ingles: This is awkward... but maybe we can work with it.
espanol: No es que me guste... Pero me las apañaré

ingles: Chery is a shy girl who devotes herself to her studies. Being so intelligent and in her own head all the time, she has a bit of difficulty with social situations... That is, until she received a mysterious proposal about a local bar recruiting girls to work there.
espanol: Chery es una chica tímida que prefiere dedicarse en cuerpo y alma a estudiar. Siempre está en su mundo y no se le da muy bien socializar... hasta que le llega una oferta de un bar de la zona que está contratando a chicas...

ingles: Although Chery was initially uncomfortable with the idea, she eventually reconsidered and accepted the invitation to join Hell Angels. After all, she really needed the extra money...
espanol: Aunque la idea no le entusiasma, al final cede y acepta la invitación de unirse al Hell Angels. Lo que sea por ganar dinero un poco de dinero extra.

ingles: Oh, I remember you... You're the guy who never showed up!
espanol: Claro que te recuerdo... ¡Eres el que no se dignó a aparecer!

ingles: Madison is Chloe's friend, another member of the book club. the main character doesn't know much about her, but she definitely caught his eye... A fact that she didn't seem to object to.
espanol: Madison es amiga de Chloe y forma parte del mismo club de lectura. El protagonista no la conoce mucho, pero le ha llamado la atención..., y a ella le gusta.

ingles: Soft spoken and a good listener
Maybe we can help each other out.

Laura is the police officer who approaches the main character after she opens up an old case linked to the events surrounding Fred and his disappearance. She became a police officer after seeing her father being wronged and forced to pay for a crime he didn't commit.
espanol: Laura se hizo policía tras ver cómo acusaban a su padre injustamente de un crimen que no cometió. Se acerca al protagonista tras comentar un caso antiguo relacionado con la desaparición de Fred.

ingles: Since then, Laura has decided to help people who find themselves in similar situations to hers to prevent others from being wrongfully convicted. She seems quite helpful and persuasive, two qualities that could help her become a strong ally in the main character's search for the truth.
espanol: A partir de ese momento, decidió ayudar a la gente que se encuentra en esa misma situación y así evitar que los condenen injustamente. Ayuda en todo lo que puede y tiene unas muy buenas dotes de persuasión, lo que la convierte en una gran aliada del protagonista en su búsqueda de la verdad.

ingles: Tyler is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. He and Claire are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, he shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether he's friend or foe there.
espanol: Tyler es estudiante de primer año en el Minerva Bay College y también va a las clases de baile de Alyssa. Conoce a Claire desde que son niños y son como uña y carne. Participa en la competición de la fraternidad, pero todavía está por ver si será un gran amigo o un gran enemigo...

ingles: Claire is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. She and Tyler are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, she shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether she's friend or foe to the girls there.
espanol: Claire acaba de llegar al Minerva Bay College y va a las clases de baile de Alyssa. Tyler y ella son amigos desde que eran niños y es raro el día que se les vea separados más de un segundo. Participa en la competición de la fraternidad, pero todavía está por ver si será una gran aliada o una enemiga de las chicas...
Su tamaño y estar al mando

ingles: Greg is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competitions. He is tall, strong, and bald. Though that certainly gives him a menacing appearance, the reality is far from it. On the contrary, he's goofy, simple-minded, and borderline cute at times. He dresses like a metalhead and likes to draw. You can see the soul of an artist lurking within.
espanol: Greg acaba de llegar al Minerva Bay College y participa en la competición de la fraternidad. Es alto, fuerte y calvo, lo que le da una apariencia un tanto amenazadora, pero es todo lo contrario: le gusta hacer bromas, es ingenuo y hasta casi mono. Se viste de negro y le encanta dibujar y, si miras fijamente, ves el alma de un artista luchando por salir.

ingles: May the force be with me

Ned is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and although he doesn't seem very threatening, he can be a handful. He's also a huge Science Fiction fan and sometimes dresses up as a Jedi...
espanol: Es el primer año de Ned en el Minerva Bay College y se ha apuntado a la competición que organiza la fraternidad. Está en el equipo contrario al del protagonista y, aunque no parece gran cosa, tiene un carácter complicado. Es un gran aficionado a la ciencia ficción y, a veces, se viste de jedi.
Seguro de sí mismo y abusón

ingles: You'll never gonna beat me, Sigma Boy!

Josh is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and every hint leads the main character to believe he'll be trouble. In addition to being a strong competitor, he's singled out the main character as his main rival and wants to make that crystal clear.
espanol: Josh acaba de entrar en el Minerva Bay College y participa en la competición que organiza la fraternidad. Está en el equipo contrario al protagonista y todo lleva a pensar que será un grano en el culo... No solo es un competidor fuerte, sino que ha decidido ir a por el protagonista y lo demuestra siempre que puede.

ingles: Kaylee is Josh's partner during the sorority competitions. We don't know much about her, but she's definitely a freshman at Minerva Bay College... or she wouldn't be competing.
espanol: Kaylee es la pareja de Josh en la competición. Solo se sabe de ella que es una estudiante de primer año en el Minerva Bay College o no estaría compitiendo...

ingles: He's the bouncer at Hell Angels, a local bar. We don't know much about him... After all, he's not much of a talker.
espanol: Es el portero de Hell Angels, un bar de la zona. No se sabe mucho de él..., y tampoco es muy hablador.

ingles: This gift is more than just a digital item — it's a symbol of appreciation for those who helped make the game possible. We designed this statue for the fans who truly care about the world we're building and want to bring a piece of it into their own homes.

ingles: We know that supporting a game is an act of trust and passion, and this small tribute is our way of giving something meaningful back — something personal, unique, and made to be proudly displayed.

This game supports a self-voicing mode in which a speech synthesizer is used to read out text and other interface elements, this is intended to make accessible to the vision impaired.
espanol: 本遊戲支持語音播報模式，通過語音合成器朗讀文本及其他界面元素。旨在爲視障人士提供無障礙遊戲體驗。

ingles: Our main character is a curious and inquisitive young man trying to find his way into adulthood as a freshman at Minerva Bay College. As he meets new friends and flirts with all sorts of girls, he does his best to deal with the ghosts of his past.
espanol: 主角是一位充滿好奇心和求知慾的年輕人，也是密涅爾灣學院的新生，正努力尋求成年人的出路。在認識新朋友、與各色女孩調情的同時，他也在盡力面對往日陰霾。

ingles: Our main character had an accident and lost a good chunk of his recent memories. As he tries to remember his past, he searches for any signs of his father's whereabouts or clues that the people around him were involved in his sudden disappearance.
espanol: 主角遭遇意外，幾乎忘了最近發生的一切。他努力回憶過去，尋找父親的下落，以及周圍的人與他突然失蹤有關的蛛絲馬跡。

ingles: Lily is married to a man she clearly doesn't love anymore, and she resents herself for it. She sees her own lost youth in our protagonist and starts feeling tempted to relive those glory days and make some different choices.
espanol: 莉莉嫁給了一個她顯然不再愛的男人，爲此感到怨恨。她在主人公身上看到了自己逝去的青春，開始渴望重溫那些輝煌的歲月，做出不同的選擇。

ingles: As a young woman, Lily gave up her promising career to build a perfect family with Sam, but her plans didn't turn out like she hoped. Now, with her marriage in tatters, she's trying to decide how to get her life back on track and make up for lost time.
espanol: 年輕時，莉莉放棄了前途無量的事業，只爲與山姆組建完美的家庭，但她的計劃卻未能如願。如今，婚姻支離破碎，她正努力思考如何讓生活重回正軌，彌補失去的時光。

ingles: Tough on the outside, sweet on the inside

Sue is a tough, bossy, independent young woman with parents out of the picture and a whole lot of attitude. However, her blunt, standoffish demeanor actually hides a sensitive, empathetic woman who dearly misses her deceased uncle, whom she loved very much.
espanol: 蘇是一位強勢、專橫、獨立的年輕女性，父母早已不在人世，性格中帶着一股傲慢和不羈。然而，她直率冷漠的外表下，潛藏着一位敏感而善解人意的女性，她深切懷念着已故的叔叔，對他懷有深厚的感情。

ingles: Susan's niece, Sue, is a rebellious girl who doesn't get along with her parents. She acts stoic and cold, with some of her words coming off as cruel, but all she wants is someone to truly listen to her.
espanol: 蘇珊的侄女蘇是個叛逆的女孩，與父母相處不來。她行事冷漠，有時很毒舌，但她真正想要的只是有人能傾聽她的心聲。

ingles: Chloe is an intelligent and charismatic girl who loves reading and watching science fiction shows like Doctor Who. She loves solving mysteries and can't contain her curiosity when it comes to discovering secrets and scandals surrounding friends and famous people around the city — especially if solving said mystery helps a friend.
espanol: 克洛伊是個聰明又有魅力的女孩，喜歡閱讀和觀看像《神祕博士》這樣的科幻劇。她熱愛解開謎團，充滿好奇心，總想要揭開朋友和城裏名流的祕密和醜聞——尤其是當這些謎團能幫助到朋友的時候。

ingles: She is outgoing and can be quite insistent when she dubs a subject compelling, but she also has a voyeuristic side that she keeps secret, liking to watch people in their most intimate moments.
espanol: 她性格外向，一旦對某個話題感興趣，就會變得非常執着。然而，她也有偷窺癖的一面，喜歡觀察人們在最私密時刻的舉止。

ingles: Susan is a college friend of the main character's mother, promising to help the boy when he signed up for school in the big city. She offered him a job and even found him a place to live. But after a closer look, she seems to know a lot about the main character's past, and her evasive manner suggests she's hiding something.
espanol: 蘇珊是主角母親的大學好友，她承諾在主角報考大城市學校時會幫助他。她給主角提供了一份工作，甚至還幫他找到了住處。但進一步瞭解後，她似乎熟知主角的過去，而她模棱兩可的態度似乎在暗示她有所隱瞞。

ingles: Susan is a widow without any children, but she has a niece named Sue who also works for her. Susan seems harsh and overbearing, but underneath all that bravado, she's a caring and loving soul who fears she'll never find love again.
espanol: 蘇珊是一位沒有子女的寡婦，但她底下有位名叫蘇的侄女爲她工作。蘇珊看起來嚴厲專橫，但在這強硬的外表下，她是一個充滿關懷的人，她害怕自己再也找不到愛情。

ingles: Julia is the kind of girl who lights up the room just by being herself — cheerful, sweet, and always ready to jump into something new (especially if that means helping a friend). Whether it be a last-minute road trip or a weekend gaming marathon, she's all in.
espanol: 茱莉亞是那種只需出現就能讓氛圍耳目一新的女孩——開朗、甜美，總是樂於嘗試新花樣（尤其是幫助朋友）。無論是臨時起意的公路旅行，還是週末的電競馬拉松，她都全力以赴。

ingles: Playful by nature and curious at heart, she has a soft spot for the unexpected, which includes her more intimate adventures. She never knows exactly where things will lead, and that thrill is half the fun.
espanol: 她天性愛玩，充滿好奇心，尤其偏愛計劃外的事情，這其中也包括一些私密的冒險。她永遠不知道事情會如何發展，而這種刺激正是一半的樂趣。

ingles: Always cheerful and good-humored, Alyssa is a determined girl with big dreams. During the day, she works as a waitress in a cafe, and at night, she teaches dance. Her dream is to have her own dance studio and form a group to take the stage with her.
espanol: 艾莉莎總是面帶微笑，開朗幽默。她是一個充滿決心和抱負的女孩。白天，她在一家咖啡館當服務員；晚上，她教跳舞。她的夢想是開間自己的舞蹈工作室，並組建舞蹈團，與他們一起登上舞臺。

ingles: Alyssa works two jobs to help her mother pay the bills and feed two younger brothers. Don't be fooled by her difficulties though; Alyssa is not a girl who sits around complaining. She's always one to find a solution, shooting down each of her problems one by one.
espanol: 艾莉莎打兩份工，來幫母親付賬單，養活兩個弟弟。不過，別被她的困境所迷惑；艾莉莎不是那種只會抱怨的女孩。她總能找到辦法，逐一解決問題。
瘋狂的鄰居，卻心懷善意

ingles: Emily is a mystery wrapped in an enigma. She seems like an airhead, but then she seems to know more than she's letting on. She gives a sort of dopey and oblivious impression, speaking in a soft tone, but there's something off about her that the main character simply can't explain.
espanol: 艾米麗謎團重重。她看似是個笨蛋，但其實遠比表面上的聰明得多。她說話輕聲細語，讓人覺得呆頭呆腦、雲裏霧裏，但她身上卻有種主角解釋不清的怪異之處。

ingles: Something in the back of the main character's mind whispers that Emily might have something to do with his past, but he can't be sure why. He can't remember anything about her being a part of his life from before.
espanol: 主角的內心深處隱約有種感覺，艾米麗或許與他的過去有關，但他卻說不清其中緣由。他完全不記得她曾是他生活中的一部分。

ingles: Devilla and her friend Angela came from Russia, and they're both working as strippers at the bar they own, known as Hell Angels. Devilla is the “bad cop” of the duo, being rather hot-headed and easy to anger. She likes to help, but she's known to ask for something in return. For some reason, she does seem to have a soft spot for our protagonist.
espanol: 德維拉和她的朋友安吉拉來自俄羅斯，她們都在自己經營的酒吧“地獄天使”裏當脫衣舞娘。德維拉是她們倆中的“壞警察”，性情暴躁，容易發怒。她樂於助人，但要求回報是出了名的。不知爲何，她似乎對我們的主角情有獨鍾。

ingles: Devilla is quite manipulative and knows how to win people over, and she's ready to use all of her skills to transform Hell Angels into the best nightclub in town. Whoever's by her side when that happens better be on good terms with her.
espanol: 德維拉城府頗深，深諳如何贏得人心。她已經準備好竭盡所能，把地獄天使打造成城裏最棒的夜店。屆時，在她身邊的人最好能和她搞好關係。

ingles: Just a good girl from Russia

Angela and her friend Devilla came from Russia, and they're both working as strippers at the bar they own, known as Hell Angels. Angela is the “good cop” of the duo, being more sweet and caring — sometimes even seeming a bit naive. However, that's just her way of nudging things toward her desired result.
espanol: 安吉拉和她的朋友德維拉是俄羅斯人，在自己經營的酒吧“地獄天使”裏擔當脫衣舞娘。安吉拉是她們倆中的“好警察”，更加溫柔體貼，有時甚至顯得有點天真。然而，她只是藉此手段引導事情發展，以達到她的目的。

ingles: Angela is a skilled entrepreneur, and despite her skills as a stripper, she studies at Minerva Bay College and dreams of turning Hell Angels into the best nightclub in town.
espanol: 安吉拉是一位才華橫溢的創業家，儘管她懂得跳脫衣舞，但她仍在密涅爾灣學院求學，並夢想將地獄天使夜總會打造成城裏頭牌。

ingles: Is my class as interesting as my tits?
espanol: 我的課有我的胸那麼有趣嗎？

ingles: Professor Watson is a new hire at Minerva Bay College, teaching economics to the likes of Dylan and the main character. She's known to be mean and likes to tease her students, especially Dylan since he failed her class once before. Still, she has a passion for her subject and her well-endowed bosom.
espanol: 沃森教授是密涅爾灣學院的新員工，負責教授迪倫和主角等人的經濟學課程。她的刁蠻是出了名的，喜歡玩弄學生，尤其是迪倫，之前就讓他掛過科。即便如此，她仍然對自己的學科充滿熱情，而且有雙傲人的巨乳。

ingles: Professor Watson is the stereotype of a hot teacher, and she knows it. With her arrogance and self-confidence, she both seduces and intimidates her students, known to make inappropriate and embarrassing comments. Will the main character be able to resist the pressure she brings?
espanol: 沃森教授是典型的性感教師，她自己也深知這一點。她傲慢自信，對學生恩威並施，說些不合時宜、讓人下不來臺的話是出了名的。主角能否抵擋住她的壓力？

ingles: Gabby is the newest lead at Angela and Devilla's bar. She's sweet, kind, and a great listener. She attends the same university as the main character and is terrified that her teachers and the faculty might learn about her side hustle.
espanol: 蓋比是安吉拉和德維拉酒吧的新任領班。她溫柔善良，善於傾聽。她和主角是校友，很擔心自己的副業被老師和教職員工發現。

ingles: Gabby's dream is to become a famous scientist, but she is willing to do whatever it takes to pay her bills and graduate college —that is, as long as she can be discreet about it and make sure it doesn't ruin her reputation.
espanol: 蓋比的夢想是成爲大科學家，但她願意盡一切努力來支付賬單並完成大學學業——只要她能保持低調，維護好自己的形象。

ingles: You scratch my back, and I'll scratch yours

Carolyne is a nurse who's been known to take jobs for Fred. She doesn't ask questions and doesn't want to answer any either. She's mysterious and keeps both her past and the circumstances she met Fred under a secret.
espanol: 卡洛琳是一名護士，曾爲弗雷德接活兒。她從不提問，也不願回答任何問題。她很神祕，對自己的過去以及與弗雷德相遇的經過都諱莫如深。

ingles: Carolyne seems to be a trustworthy person, willing to help the main character with his daddy issues. She's charming and confident, seeming to honestly care about the main character's well-being.
espanol: 卡洛琳似乎是個值得信賴的人，願意幫助主角解決父子間的爭端。她迷人且自信，似乎真切關心主角的幸福。

ingles: Mae is a regular customer of Susan's. She is a masseuse with a particular interest in the main character after he's tasked with delivering a package to her. Mae is soft-spoken and very eager to get her hands on whatever man comes her way.
espanol: 梅是蘇珊的常客。她是一名按摩師，自從主角給她送包裹後，她就對他特別感興趣。梅說話輕聲細語，只要遇到男人都渴望將其佔有。

ingles: Mae cares a lot about her looks, so she doesn't look her age even though she's in her forties. She seems to be an influential person in Minerva Bay, and although she's discreet, she seems to take a liking to the younger boys...
espanol: 梅很在意自己的外貌，因此儘管她已年過四十，看起來卻一點也不顯老。她在密涅爾灣似乎很有影響力，雖然她行事低調，但似乎對年輕男孩頗有好感……

ingles: If life gives you lemons... use them to shoot vodka!
espanol: 如果生活給你檸檬……就用它們釀伏特加！

ingles: Dylan is the main character's best friend. He's carefree and always joking — with a flair for the dramatic. Although he talks normally around the main character, Dylan pretends to be Russian around the ladies.
espanol: 迪倫是主角最好的朋友。他無憂無慮，總愛開玩笑——而且總能搞出點意外情況。他在主角面前說話很正常，但在女生面前裝作俄羅斯人。

ingles: Even though he's somehow managed to hide this big secret from others, Dylan is a great friend that the main character can count on for even the craziest of adventures. He would literally drive across the country to get a friend out of trouble.
espanol: 儘管迪倫設法向其他人隱瞞了這個天大的祕密，但他仍然是主角值得信賴的摯友，即使是最瘋狂的冒險也會助其一臂之力。他會不惜驅車橫跨全國，只爲幫朋友脫困。

ingles: I'd do anything for my family

The main character's mother is a loving person, but she can be rather overprotective and seems to know more than she lets on. She can be a bit overbearing, but it's always with the best of intentions.
espanol: 主角的母親是個充滿愛心的人，但她有時會過度保護，且遠沒有表面上的懵懂單純。她有時略顯霸道，但總是秉持善心。

ingles: Debra loves Fred unconditionally, leaving questions about how complicit she was in Fred's business. Perhaps she really was completely oblivious to everything that happened in the past.
espanol: 黛布拉無條件地愛着弗雷德，這讓人不禁質疑她與弗雷德的生意究竟有多深的牽連。或許她真的對往事一無所知。

ingles: I have to prove my innocence
espanol: 我必須證明自己的清白

ingles: Fred is the main character's father. He's been missing for fifteen years after a bad deal went south, leading to his being arrested. He wants to be reunited with his family more than anything else and is willing to do whatever it takes to do so.
espanol: 弗雷德是主角的父親。他在一次失敗的交易後失蹤了十五年，最終被捕入獄。他最渴望的就是與家人團聚，並且不惜一切。

ingles: On top of that, Fred seeks revenge against the person he believes to be truly responsible for his fate and will do everything to ensure that the truth about his past is revealed and that the guilty parties are punished.
espanol: 除此之外，弗雷德還決心向導致他走到這一步的人報仇，並會不惜一切代價揭開過去的真相，讓罪魁禍首受到應有的懲罰。

ingles: Sam is Lily's husband and the co-owner of a large investment firm. He's possessive and gets angry easily. When he's at his best though, he is an extremely charming man. He did a lot of business with Fred in the past and is one of the prime suspects behind his disappearance.
espanol: 山姆是莉莉的丈夫，也是一家大型投資公司的合夥人。他佔有慾極強，容易生氣。但在他狀態好的時候，他卻是個極具魅力的男人。他過去和弗雷德做過很多生意，也是弗雷德失蹤案的主要嫌疑人之一。

ingles: After all his investigating, the main character is convinced that Sam is the real villain behind his father's disappearance. But will the main character be able to prove his suspicions?
espanol: 經過一番調查，主角確信山姆纔是他父親失蹤的幕後黑手。但主角能否證實他的懷疑呢？

ingles: Charlie was Susan's husband and a partner of both Fred and Sam. He always stood for what was right in the business, so when things took a turn for the worse, he was quick to turn on his partners. This, in turn, made Fred and Sam resent him.
espanol: 查理是蘇珊的丈夫，也是弗雷德和薩姆的合夥人。他總是在生意場上堅持正義，所以一旦走勢不妙，他總會迅速與合夥人決裂。這反過來又讓弗雷德和薩姆對他心生怨恨。

ingles: Charlie passed away in a traffic accident a few years ago.
espanol: 查理幾年前在一場車禍中去世了。

ingles: Life is a mole on a chick's ass... You just got to have fun with it!
espanol: 生活就像小妞屁股上的一顆痣……儘管逗弄就行了！

ingles: Bruce is a senior at Minerva Bay College and the head of the Sigma-Pi-Nu fraternity. Along with his girlfriend Heather, he organizes parties and other events to welcome the freshmen to campus, enjoying when he can cause mayhem and mischief at the university. The more epic, the better!
espanol: 布魯斯是密涅爾灣學院的一名高年級學生，也是狂拽酷兄弟會的會長。他和女友希瑟一起組織派對和其他活動，歡迎新生入學，熱衷於在校園裏搗亂，大搞惡作劇。亂子越大越好！

ingles: Well... let's see what you're capable of.
espanol: 嗯……讓我們看看你的能耐。

ingles: Heather is a senior at Minerva Bay College, and she doesn't seem to like the main character very much. She's Bruce's girlfriend, and she enjoys picking on the freshmen during fraternity events. The main character wants to do everything he can to convince her that he is, in fact, a nice guy who deserves her respect. But will he succeed?
espanol: 希瑟是密涅爾灣學院的一名高年級學生，她似乎不太喜歡主角。她是布魯斯的女朋友，喜歡在兄弟會活動上捉弄新生。主角想盡一切辦法，向她證明自己其實是個值得尊敬的好人。但他能成功嗎？

ingles: Donna is the vice dean at Minerva Bay College and is currently extremely unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. With her aggressive and uncompromising stance, she vows to combat lewd behavior from her students, known to fight fiercely for morals and righteous behavior.
espanol: 唐娜是密涅爾灣學院的副院長，目前對學校走向墮落極爲不滿。她秉持着強硬且不妥協的立場，誓要打擊學生羣體的猥褻行爲，以捍衛道德和正義而聞名。

ingles: When Donna discovers that some university students work and live at a local bar that is home to a number of unbecoming activities, she begins a campaign against the owners.
espanol: 當唐娜發現一些大學生在當地一家酒吧工作和生活，而這家酒吧卻存在許多不雅行爲時，她開始對酒吧老闆發起抗議活動。

ingles: Maybe we can solve this with a simple conversation
espanol: 也許我們能簡單聊聊，解決這個問題

ingles: Jack is the dean of the university, but his position seems to be under threat from Donna, unhappy with the perverse direction the university is taking. Jack doesn't seem to be making any effort to maintain morality and righteous behavior within the university. In fact, he might even be taking a few liberties with his power. However, this has left some members of the board less than pleased. Could his position be under threat?
espanol: 傑克是這所大學的院長，但他的地位似乎受到了唐娜的威脅，唐娜對學校的墮落感到不滿。傑克似乎並沒有努力維護學校的道德規範和正義行徑。事實上，他甚至可能濫用職權。然而，這讓一些董事會成員感到不滿。他的職位會受到威脅嗎？

ingles: This isn't in the rules... but I'll see what I can do.
espanol: 這不合規定……但我盡力吧。

ingles: Janine works at Minerva Bay College as a secretary. She has a soft spot for Dylan but is otherwise a very conservative person who values 'decency' above all else.
espanol: 珍妮在密涅爾灣學院擔任祕書。她對迪倫情有獨鍾，但除此之外，她是一個非常保守的人，最看重體面。

ingles: What luck! It must be because the planets are aligned!
espanol: 真幸運！肯定是因爲合乎星象！

ingles: Jessa is athletic, full of attitude, and has a biting sense of humor. She's a freshman at Minerva Bay College is looking for alternative ways to earn more money to support herself.
espanol: 傑莎熱愛運動，個性張揚，爲人幽默。她是密涅爾灣學院的一名新生，正在尋找其他賺錢的途徑來養活自己。

ingles: Jessa heard there was a local bar recruiting girls to work there and saw it as a good opportunity to get some extra income. She sees the looks men are always giving her, and she doesn't mind using that to her advantage.
espanol: 傑莎聽說當地一家酒吧正在招募女孩，覺得這是個賺外快的好機會。她看到男人們總是朝她投來異樣的目光，也很樂意利用這一點。

ingles: This is awkward... but maybe we can work with it.
espanol: 這很尷尬……但也許我們可以想辦法解決。

ingles: Chery is a shy girl who devotes herself to her studies. Being so intelligent and in her own head all the time, she has a bit of difficulty with social situations... That is, until she received a mysterious proposal about a local bar recruiting girls to work there.
espanol: 琦蕊是個害羞的女孩，一心撲在學業上。她聰明伶俐，但總是沉浸在自己的世界裏，所以在社交場合有些不自在……直到她收到一份神祕的邀請：當地某家酒吧正在招聘女孩。

ingles: Although Chery was initially uncomfortable with the idea, she eventually reconsidered and accepted the invitation to join Hell Angels. After all, she really needed the extra money...
espanol: 儘管琦蕊最初對這個提議感到不舒服，但她最終還是改變了主意，接受了加入地獄天使的邀請。畢竟，她迫切需要賺點外快……

ingles: Oh, I remember you... You're the guy who never showed up!
espanol: 啊，我記得你……你就是那個從未出現過的人！

ingles: Madison is Chloe's friend, another member of the book club. the main character doesn't know much about her, but she definitely caught his eye... A fact that she didn't seem to object to.
espanol: 麥迪遜是克洛伊的朋友，也是書友會的成員。主角對她瞭解不多，但她絕對吸引了他的注意……而克洛伊似乎並不介意。

ingles: Soft spoken and a good listener
Maybe we can help each other out.

Laura is the police officer who approaches the main character after she opens up an old case linked to the events surrounding Fred and his disappearance. She became a police officer after seeing her father being wronged and forced to pay for a crime he didn't commit.
espanol: 勞拉是一位警官，因接手了一起與弗雷德失蹤事件相關的舊案而主動接近主角。她親眼目睹父親遭受冤屈，被迫爲莫須有的罪行付出代價，於是決定成爲一名警官。

ingles: Since then, Laura has decided to help people who find themselves in similar situations to hers to prevent others from being wrongfully convicted. She seems quite helpful and persuasive, two qualities that could help her become a strong ally in the main character's search for the truth.
espanol: 自那以後，勞拉就決定幫助那些與她處境相似的人，不願坐視其他人被冤枉。她樂於助人，又言語伶俐，憑藉這兩點，她有望成爲主角追尋真相的堅實盟友。

ingles: Tyler is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. He and Claire are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, he shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether he's friend or foe there.
espanol: 泰勒是密涅爾灣學院的新生，同時還加入了艾莉莎的舞蹈學校。他和克萊爾是兒時好友，經常形影不離。在兄弟會比賽期間，他出現在參賽者中，不過他是敵是友還有待觀察。

ingles: Claire is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who also attends Alyssa's dance school. She and Tyler are childhood friends and are always seen together. During the fraternity competition, she shows up among the competitors, though it's to be seen whether she's friend or foe to the girls there.
espanol: 克萊爾是密涅爾灣學院的新生，同時還加入了艾莉莎的舞蹈學校。她和泰勒是兒時好友，經常形影不離。在兄弟會比賽期間，她出現在參賽者中，不過她是敵是友還有待觀察。
讓我們給海報弄點塗鴉！

ingles: Greg is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competitions. He is tall, strong, and bald. Though that certainly gives him a menacing appearance, the reality is far from it. On the contrary, he's goofy, simple-minded, and borderline cute at times. He dresses like a metalhead and likes to draw. You can see the soul of an artist lurking within.
espanol: 格雷格是密涅爾灣學院的新生，正在參加兄弟會的比賽。他身材高大，體格健壯，而且禿頂。雖然他這副樣子有些嚇人，但其實並非如此。相反，他有點傻乎乎的，頭腦簡單，有時還帶着幾分可愛。他穿得像個金屬樂迷，喜歡畫畫。從他身上能一窺藝術家的靈魂。

ingles: May the force be with me

Ned is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and although he doesn't seem very threatening, he can be a handful. He's also a huge Science Fiction fan and sometimes dresses up as a Jedi...
espanol: 內德是密涅爾灣學院的一名新生，正在參加兄弟會比賽。他所在的隊伍的對手是主角，雖然主角看起來並不怎麼具有威脅，但其實很難對付。他也是狂熱的科技迷，有時會打扮成絕地武士……

ingles: You'll never gonna beat me, Sigma Boy!
espanol: 你永遠不是我的對手，臭小子！

ingles: Josh is a freshman at Minerva Bay College who is taking part in the fraternity competition. He's on the team competing against the main character, and every hint leads the main character to believe he'll be trouble. In addition to being a strong competitor, he's singled out the main character as his main rival and wants to make that crystal clear.
espanol: 喬許是密涅爾灣學院的新生，正在參加兄弟會比賽。他所在的隊伍正在和主角競爭，而種種跡象都讓主角覺得他會是個麻煩。除了實力強勁之外，他還把主角視爲自己的主要對手，且想方設法地刁難他。

ingles: Kaylee is Josh's partner during the sorority competitions. We don't know much about her, but she's definitely a freshman at Minerva Bay College... or she wouldn't be competing.
espanol: 凱莉是喬許在姐妹會比賽中的搭檔。我們對她知之甚少，但她肯定是米涅爾灣學院的大一新生……否則她不會參加比賽。

ingles: He's the bouncer at Hell Angels, a local bar. We don't know much about him... After all, he's not much of a talker.
espanol: 他是當地一家名爲“地獄天使”的酒吧的保安。我們對他了解不多……畢竟，他不太健談。

ingles: With thanks, a gift for you

As a thank you to everyone who continues to believe in our project and chose to support the game by purchasing the Supporter Pack, we've prepared a special gift: an exclusive 3D-printable file for a figurine of Julia.
espanol: 爲了感謝所有一直相信我們的項目、選擇通過購買贊助包來支持遊戲的人，我們準備了一份特別的禮物：茱莉亞手辦的獨家 3D 打印文件。

ingles: This gift is more than just a digital item — it's a symbol of appreciation for those who helped make the game possible. We designed this statue for the fans who truly care about the world we're building and want to bring a piece of it into their own homes.
espanol: 這份禮物不僅僅是一件數字商品，更是對那些爲遊戲的誕生做出貢獻的人們表達感謝的象徵。我們爲那些真正關心我們所構建的世界，並希望將其中的一部分帶回家的粉絲們設計了這座雕像。

ingles: We know that supporting a game is an act of trust and passion, and this small tribute is our way of giving something meaningful back — something personal, unique, and made to be proudly displayed.
espanol: 我們深知，支持一款遊戲是基於信任與熱情的舉動，而這份小小的致敬正是我們以實際行動回饋玩家的方式——一份充滿個人情感、獨一無二且值得展示的禮物。

ingles: To download the statue file, log into your OppaiMan account and confirm your Supporter registration.
espanol: 要下載雕像文件，請登錄你的 OppaiMan 帳戶並確認支持者註冊信息。

ingles: Restart the game to apply graphics settings
espanol: 重啓遊戲以應用圖形設置

ingles: Tear frames when the game can't keep up with its intended framerate.
espanol: 當遊戲無法達到其預期的幀率時，出現畫面撕裂。

ingles: lower frame rate to save power.
While you play, a hearth icon may suddenly appear on the screen.
espanol: 遊戲過程中，爐火圖標可能會突然出現在屏幕上。

ingles: When you see it, tap quickly!
If you click in time, you will receive a collectible card booster.
espanol: 若您及時點擊，即可獲得一張可收藏卡牌補充包。
錯過了一個調皮的小祕密！

ingles: Skip text you already seen in the game.
When turned ON, skipping will resume after a choice
espanol: 開啓後，進行選擇後將繼續跳過
跳過場景之間的視覺過渡。

ingles: Highlight the best choices in green, helping you easily identify the most optimal decisions as you play.
espanol: 用綠色高亮最佳選擇，幫助你在遊玩期間輕鬆識別最佳決策。

ingles: This game contains adult content and is intended for mature audiences only.
espanol: 該遊戲含有成人內容，僅供成人觀看。

ingles: All characters depicted are fictional and over the legal age of 18.
espanol: 所有登場角色純屬虛構，且皆已年滿法定的18歲。

ingles: This version of the game is not compatible with Season 1 Web Saves.
espanol: 此版本的遊戲與第一季的網頁存檔不兼容。

ingles: Attempting to load them may result in errors and crashes. In these cases, it is recommended to start a new game.
espanol: 嘗試加載這些文件可能會導致錯誤和崩潰。在這種情況下，建議開始新遊戲。

espanol: 我已閱讀並接受使用條款

espanol: 已知您當前使用的模組充滿BUG，會導致遊戲崩潰。

ingles: Remove any mods and restart the game.
espanol: 刪除所有模組並重啓遊戲。

espanol: 若想支持遊戲幕後的十人團隊：

ingles: (Optional) Get the OFFICIAL version because all money is invested back into more content.
espanol: （可選）獲取官方版本，因爲所有資金都已投入到更多內容的產出。

ingles: Our main character is a curious and inquisitive young man trying to find his way into adulthood as a freshman at Minerva Bay College. As he meets new friends and flirts with all sorts of girls, he does his best to deal with the ghosts of his past.
espanol: ตัวละครหลักของเราคือชายหนุ่มผู้ใฝ่รู้และอยากรู้อยากเห็น ที่กำลังก้าวเข้าสู่วัยผู้ใหญ่ในฐานะนักศึกษาปีหนึ่งที่วิทยาลัยอ่าวมิเนอร์ว่า ในระหว่างที่เขาได้พบกับเพื่อนใหม่และจีบสาวๆ มากมาย เขาก็ต้องพยายามอย่างเต็มที่เพื่อรับมือกับมารผจญที่ตามหลอกหลอนเขาจากอดีต

ingles: Our main character had an accident and lost a good chunk of his recent memories. As he tries to remember his past, he searches for any signs of his father's whereabouts or clues that the people around him were involved in his sudden disappearance.
espanol: ตัวละครหลักของเราประสบอุบัติเหตุและสูญเสียความทรงจำในช่วงที่ผ่านมาไปเป็นจำนวนมาก ขณะที่เขาพยายามนึกถึงอดีต เขาก็ค้นหาคำใบ้ใดๆ ที่บ่งบอกถึงร่องรอยของพ่อ หรือเบาะแสต่างๆ ที่บ่งชี้ว่าผู้คนรอบข้างมีส่วนเกี่ยวข้องกับการหายตัวไปอย่างกะทันหันของเขาอย่างไร
พนักงานขายอสังหาริมทรัพย์
ไร้ความมั่นใจและขี้ขุ่นเคือง
อาบน้ำเป็นเวลานาน
